system.description:
The Asuri Sect wields the emotions and passions that are so often spurned by exoteric, conventional contemplation cults.

License: Demon Body ✦

Needs: ❂

After barking out a taunt, the Cultivator may EXUDE KILLING INTENT to draw the ire of all those within [5 + Killing Intent] meters of her. All within her aura gets a temporary Attachment of Intimidation toward her as long as they're within the aura's range. All attempts to KILL THE BUDDHA against her suffer -2, as if affectd by the Attachment. If she damages anyone within her Killing Intent, they must succeed on a Demand [DEMON BODY] HRT + STILLNESS Check or lose 1 Morale. This only affects entities that are of equal or lower Sidhi Stages.

Asuri fight with an indomitable and intimidating fury. Unrelenting, their very faces and miens change. They fight by brutalizing with hands and with giant weapons. Cleaving through and splitting God’s head from His body.

License: Demon Body ✦✦

Needs: ✹; melee weapon

While internalized, ignore the SPD Modifier of GREAT or COLOSSAL weapons. When the Cultivator deals damage, she may activate this to let that damage be blast damage.
system.tags: Asuri, Demon Body, ✦✦, Technick, melee weapon

system.description:
"Asuri are exceptionally hard headed. It helps. Those that are too soft or bend too easily crumble to the conditoining needed to master DEMON BODY."

License: Demon Body ✦✦

Needs: ❂

While installed, the Asuri reduces all damage to her Head by 1. All her damage with her head rises by 1, and she can stun opponents with it if she manages to slam her own head against the target's head.

To strengthen one’s body beyond its limits is to eat the face of god. Spit it out, don’t swallow. See? You’ve eaten yourself. The Vajra Warriors abused this technick to the point that their normal muscles were so limp that they could not move without activating this meditation beforehand.

License: Demon Body ✦✦

Needs: ❂

The Cultivator installs RED BLACK DEMON THEWS to empower their muscles to the highest limit. While installed, all damage she inflicts also deals KNOCKBACK up to [2 + DEMON BODY] meters after damaging. If she uses this upon an immovable object or terrain, she launches herself instead.

Asuri wield their Sidhi to strengthen their musculature. Their Microcosmic Orbits become complexes of pistons and intramat hydraulics to strengthen their bodies. The Asuri are highly sought after, but many gang bosses know Asuri Licenses themselves.

License: Demon Body ✦✦

Needs: ✹

On a Controlled Torso—even on one just newly established—the Cultivator can hurl the entire body of that target. She hurls them up to [5 x DEMON BODY] meters in any direction, even up (to Juggle) or down (to Knockdown and inflict Falling damage). If the target collides with a thick wall, he is embedded into it from intramaterial the force of the Hurl.

"Set your heart ablaze!" — Elder Asuri Masao The Asuri Sect take their name after the mythological Antigods that went against the Devas. Their strikes thunder and strike fear even to the Highest of Thrones, thus it was integral to MORTAR to sublate the Asuri into the neoliberal capitalist fold. The Asuri revel being in the midst of the fight. They are taught to drink the blood of their enemies.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

Upon inflicting damage with a weapon, activate KURUKULLA BLOOD DRINKING to heal one Part by [DEMON BODY].

More than just anger, the Asuri Sect wields explosive libido—that is, Desire, not just in the sexual sense—as a poison from which the antidote can be cured.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦

Needs: —

The Asuri can speak the language of chaos and demonkind. She is no longer susceptible to any fear-based or intimidation-based influences and can use her DEMON BODY when socializing demonkind. At any point, she can offer a desire of her own aloud. If the listener freely names one in return, each witnesses the other’s desire as a brief sensory vision.

A rare technick used by the Asuri Akinna Kejor when she had to fight through a hellworld seeping into Hingsajagra. She synthesized this into a Technick after getting out and making sure that she slew 100 demons with it.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

The Asuri swings her weapon and sends an explosion of devilcutting in a 5m long, 10m wide cone fulmination. All that fail to avoid the swing suffer [CRUSHING] weapon damage.

Who’s to say that demonkind are not subject to the targeted propaganda of bourgeois media and ideology? The Asuri Sect steal away the Sidhi that has been stolen from them since the beginning.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

The Cultivator can now KILL THE BUDDHA against any number of targets within weapon reach at once: she makes a single KILL THE BUDDHA with +1d per hostile targeted, and each hostile makes the check against her. She can Flurry all that she is eligible to, and only needs to resolve her RECOVERY normally afterwards.

Even the vaunted heavenly armors of the gods stand no chance against the might of the Antigods. This Technick—passed down by the first Asuri—renders all protective soak moot against sheer brute violence.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

When the Cultivator deals damage and any amount is Soaked, she can activate VAJRA-SUNDERING VAJRA to immediately destroy all Soak for that Part, and then deal damage anyway + the number of Soak destroyed.

The greatest of the Asuri was said to be Dattreya Wairini herself, who was a student of Jenma Malari. Applying Dialectic Luciferianism, Dattreya synthesized passion and serenity, lust and asceticism, self and other, into the elevated form of Passion, which overcame the unnecessary duality, and revealed to her the True Nature of Reality and the innermost Divine Workings of Matter.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

When the Cultivator enters Samadhi, she may activate this to enter her Chthonian Seraph Body, to a limit of [PHYSIQUE] hours. While in this body, her skin turns the color of her Sidhi and she gains an extra set of arms that can hold other weapons or make other attacks: she gains +2 to all KILL THE BUDDHAs. While in this Body, she can burn ✹ to remove a Strike from her opponent in a KILL THE BUDDHA.

Devil Tigers are ancient, elder things. Tiger only in the way of mien, but not in gross physical form. These Devil Tigers conquered the world. They took on the forms of impervious Adamantine Humans. They are primordial beasts. They are the first Buddhas, burdened to slay the seraphim that came before, like mosquitos to a god corpse.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹

This attack can only target a single entity. It is a horrible single slash: she can activate SPITEFUL DISEMBOWELMENT OF SERAPHIM to immediately inflict double blast damage on the target's Torso as her blade cleaves through.

items.name: Mountain of Corpses, Seas of Blood

system.description:
"The giants of old shaped entire Spheres..." — The Codex of the Ancients

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹✹✹

The Cultivator exhales, and burning Sidhi cloud-refuse billows. Then, she disappears into the violence: she deals weapon damage+1 as a Fulmination to all entities within 30m.

Ensure no word leaves the victim's lips.

License: Devil Beast ✦

Needs: ✹; EMPTY HAND; DAGGER; SABER

Attack from behind or by surprise: +1 damage. The target can’t speak, scream, or cast Magick for 1 minute, even if they survive.
system.tags: Aswang, Devil Beast, ✦, Technick, EMPTY HAND; DAGGER; SABER

system.description:
…and every sword strike is met with a dancing thorn of scarlet…

License: Devil Beast ✦

Needs: ❂; EMPTY HAND; DAGGER; SABER

When the Cultivator draws blood: install the ASWANG FANG to inflict a [FANG]—a thaumaturgical neurotoxin. ⟢ Any being with a [FANG] suffers +1 damage from any source. ⟢ Consume a [FANG] at any time to shift into a mist or a swarm of bats or insects and fly adjacent to the consumed FANG’s target. This burns the Flame installed to that Fang. ⟢ Can be removed by an entity with [FANG] with a PHYS + ADAMANCE vs Cultivator's HRT + DEVIL BEAST. A succesful removal forces the Cultivator to release the Flame.
system.tags: Aswang, Devil Beast, ✦, Technick, EMPTY HAND; DAGGER; SABER

system.description:
…until all the darknesses in the world deflowers her and she realizes…

License: Devil Beast ✦✦

Needs: ❂

The Cultivator splits herself in half. Her lower body stays where it is but her upper body moves around and can fly up to double her normal movement speed. She cannot go farther than 120m from her lower body. Any attack made against her lower body affects her upper body as well.

…and she would bring about midnight in an arc across the wheel…

License: Devil Beast ✦✦

Needs: ❂

The Cultivator steps 2m and leaves behind a single Shadow of herself. It shares the Cultivator's Cultivations but does not take its own actions. A Demand [DEVIL BEAST] [Wits + Peripheral Oracle] Check must be passed by those near it or hostile to it to find out that it's just a shadow of the Cultivator. When the Shadow is damaged, it immediately dissipates and the Flame is released. All hostiles within 3m of the shadow have -1 to their next Check. When the Cultivator is hit, before damage, she can swap places with the Shadow immediately and have the Shadow suffer the instead.

The very phenomenon of consciousness arises from the self-awareness of death. The very phenomenon of consciousness arises from the self-awareness of death. We only think because we will die. And so let us revel.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦

Needs: ✹; EMPTY HAND; DAGGER; SABER

The Cultivator activate this when she Steps to teleport [DEVIL BEAST/2]m instead.
system.tags: Aswang, Devil Beast, ✦✦, Technick, EMPTY HAND; DAGGER; SABER

system.description:
Seize and control with a curved weapon with inhuman speed.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦

Needs: ✹; EMPTY HAND; DAGGER; SABER

Upon dealing damage to a Limb, activate DEMON CLAW to immediately Control that Limb. If the Limb is a Leg, can pull it instead to immediately knockdown.
system.tags: Aswang, Devil Beast, ✦✦, Technick, EMPTY HAND; DAGGER; SABER

system.description:
…and the blood would sheathe her in shadow… Worry not, neophyte. You are already a murderer. The very act of living means you are killing yourself.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

When the Cultivator moves into a place where no hostile can see her, she can use this to turn invisible. When the Aswang ambushes, she can uninstall the Flame to immediately generate 2 Strikes. This ends immediately upon performing a hostile action.

…and then the beauty of her suffering is vindicated with seven horrible syllables as she realizes…

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

When the Aswang installs the Flame, choose one of her Parts and name a beast. That Part assumes a living aspect of the beast. Describe the change and name one faculty its anatomy grants. While transformed, the Part can do whatever that faculty physically permits. The Aswang directs it as her own flesh. The transformation replaces the Part’s ordinary anatomy. An arm become a serpent can bite and coil. To wield a sword in that hand again, the Aswang must release the Flame. The transformed Part retains its damage and can be targeted and Controlled as usual. Releasing the Flame restores its human shape. She can move a Disabled Limb in this way.

To be initiated into the Aswang, the Cultivator must ritually murder a being. The target must be a person of significance—a tyrant, an oppressor, a bourgeois, a capitalist, a traitor, an enemy of the People.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

The Cultivator sends a dance of black razors to erupt from her, shooting it in a vicious 7m long and 10m wide fulmination cone from her. The Razors deal [DEVIL BEAST] pierce damage.

The killing must be executed alone, in silence, and the Exdead must spend the night with the corpse, meditating on the nature of death and the exact moment of transition. At the end of the Vigil, the Aswang undergoes a Tribulation: their own self, coming to kill herself. She must fight off her own assassin, herself.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

The Cultivator can activate UMBRAL PHASING STYLE to turn any one of her Parts intangible: she cannot affect anyone with that Part (and whatever it's holding) but no one else can affect that Part either, as her physical signature is entangled into a different dimensional frequency.

After Initiation—the ingesting of the vaunted Devil's Centipede, the Cultivation Womb takes on the shape of a Charnel Mandala: a complex geometric pattern of interconnected deathmoments, each node a kill, each line a thread of fatal intent.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹✹✹; DAGGER; SABER

The Cultivator uses this to perform a KILL THE BUDDHA with [DEVIL BEAST]. This KTB begins with 6 Strikes.
system.tags: Aswang, Devil Beast, ✦✦✦✦✦, Technick, DAGGER; SABER

system.description:
…all things in this world are but fabrications of the human mind.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

The Aswang can take on the shape of entities and beings that she has eaten or had sex with before. She largely preserves her traits and statistics while in this other form. Eating another entity’s Flesh recovers 1 burnt Flame or heals a random Part 1 HP. It can also fill the Protein requirement for a full meal. The Aswang can reach out and install ❂❂❂❂ to shape the flesh of another entity. If they’re willing, this goes smoothly. If not, this becomes an Conflict Check: PHYSIQUE + DEVIL BEAST vs HRT + ADAMANCE. If the Cultivator wins, they deal 2 true damage to the Part being changed, and then the caster may forcibly shape their flesh.

The consummation of the Devil Beast. Become the utlimate monster.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂...

The Cultivator immediately transforms into a chimerical devil beast body that has multiple paradoxical and interpenetrating flesh parts. Choose 1 per installed Flame: ✦ Rictus Grin Shrine: Gain another face and mouth beside your first. ✦ Devil Beast Claws: Empty Hand deals +2 damage and cuts. ✦ Beastman Thews: +1 to any melee weapon check. ✦ Monstrous Shintai: +1 to Size. ✦ Divine Altar: +1 to all Investigation and UNRAVEL HEAVEN'S LAWS Checks. ✦ Foxfire Beauty: The form gains a beautiful mien instead of a chimerical mien that cannot be pierced without powerful sorceries. ✦ Exoskeleton: The form gains +2 Soak to all Parts. ✦ Terrifying Argent Visage: The form becomes exceedingly horrible to look at: dealing damage also inflicts -1 Morale on the target.

Kyi Kun-tze cast his spear across the gulf and stepped from the cliff after it. Both struck the far wall together. When his disciples asked how he had flown so swiftly, he bade them look at the depth of his footprints in the wall.

License: Sky Dragon ✦

Needs: ❂

While installed, the Cultivator gain the movement benefits of Lightness Technique even without moving—perfect balance and feeling like half the weight and the Cultivator can use this even when carrying the 1x of their Carry limit. When the Cultivator KILLS THE BUDDHA while installed, she can tread open air freely, though she must hit the ground at the end of the KILL THE BUDDHA.

The Dracontinesʼ ability to ascend into the heavens was said to be one of the first things taught to them by the Dragon Buddhas.

License: Sky Dragon ✦

Needs: ✹; POLEARM OR DAGGER

The Dracontine shoots up 6m and then down to any point within 6m horizontally. If there's a target there, she must win a MOTORICS + SKY DRAGON vs the target's WITS + THEWS AND SINEWS. On a failure, she hits the ground and cracks it as the target moves out of the way. On a success, she deals weapon damage + 1 to a random Part.

system.description:
In many languages, such as in Kemrese, the word for Dragon—teruk—is also the word for thunder. The Dracontines' tutelary deity is Akshandata, the Heaven Wielder, who is a wrathful emanation of the peaceful buddha Amasantu. Their Sect founder is the legendary Underworld hero Kyi Kun-tze, who is said to hold the blood of the dragon himself.

License: Sky Dragon ✦

Needs: ❂; POLEARM OR DAGGER

While installed, Daggers gain [REACH] and the Dracontine can SKEWER: with the needed weapon, she can deal damage and pin a Limb to a particular part of the terrain/environment and leave the weapon there.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
Dragons are sometimes known as naka, sometimes known as ruong, sometimes as loong. These are powerful, potent, reptilian beasts with a mastery over the elements of nature, can summon wind and rain, and arrive with the crashing of thunder.

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦

Needs: ✹✹; POLEARM OR DAGGER

The Dracontine unleashes an impossible cavalcade of thrusts, so quick that it seems as if the Dracontine has a hundred spears striking at once. KILL THE BUDDHA against all in a 3m wide cone in front of the Cultivator.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
During the Revolution, the Invincible Blade Princess used their sky flying capabilities to hunt down enemy dragons. It was a massacre—one that the dragons are sure to never forget.

License: Sky Dragon ✦

Needs: ✹

Use this technick to immediately dash [3 + SKY DRAGON] in any direction, even while in midair. Can use this even within KILL THE BUDDHA or while JUGGLED to remove Juggled or during Forced Movement to negate remaining forced movement.

The Sky Pillar is an ancient, seemingly lost mountain realm in the Ceiling of the World, where the greatest of dragons lived for some time. The Sky Dragons ruled here, but were amicable with the Water and Earth Dragons, who were worshipped.

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦

Needs: ✹; POLEARM OR DAGGER

The Cultivator strikes in a sudden rising arc, infused with Skyborne Sidhi. Upon dealing damage with a needed weapon, launch them 5m back and 5m into the air, inflicting Juggled. And then immediately rapid move adjacent to the victim.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
You could have left the earth by now. Unfettered by gravityʼs chains. You could have become free… but you chose to return to the earth. To gravity. A true dragon bodhisattva. You are the thunder.

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

MANTRA: KADMA DRUK SKYOD | MUDRA: WISDOM CAST CHECK: PHYSIQUE + SKY DRAGON CHARGE TIME 6 EFFECT: Launch into the skies—leap up to 20m and then stay airborne for as long as the Flame is Installed. The Dracontine’s Flying movement is equal to [SKY DRAGON]m/s.

The Dracontines used to be an ancient elite vanguard that fought for the Shennin Heavenly Empress: the Invincible Blade Princess. After the Revolutions, they were subjected to rigorous criticism and rehabilitation. Even in the End of All Things, a large number of Dracontines are sympathetic to the Revolutionist Alignments.

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹; POLEARM OR DAGGER

The Cultivator unleashes a sudden powerful spear attack by gripping their polearm with both hands, twisting quickly and suddenly thrusting their spear backwards and up. Like a horse-lancer wheeling around to strike at the foe behind them. The Cultivator may immediately flash-step past the target and then strike backwards. This is an undodgeable KILL THE BUDDHA attempt. She can use this to DODGE a KILL THE BUDDHA attempt at her. If she does, she launches the target 3m into the air.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦✦✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
Unleash! Revel! The Dragon Buddhas hath saith thus: to kill is to incur the karma of hell. But to kill in compassion of the other—for the betterment of all—is a killing that requires the two core essences of Enlightenment: Wisdom and Compassion. To perform this Enlightened Killing still accrues Karma, but this is a Karma a Buddha will gladly suffer for the sake of All Beings. And in this practice the reverend Buddha soberly understands the truth: that even Karma is Not True!

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹; POLEARM OR DAGGER

The Dracontine spins her spear and summons draconic Sidhi as she does. At the height of the spin, she releases it in a straight line. Draconic Sidhi creates a lance of tyrant rage and fervor: this is a Fulmination in a 6m long straight line, 1m wide, that deals pierce damage to all Torsos within.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦✦✦✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
The Dragon Buddhaʼs own martial art is said to be lost to time. Savage Carving Fang was once known as the Eighty-Eight Million Galaxy Dragon Fury, but only 5 of its attacks were preserved. Perhaps an Immortal Cultivator of greater skill will be able to find the scattered and lost strikes of the Fury. It is said that only a True Dragon Buddha can perform the sacrosanct technick once again.

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹; POLEARM OR DAGGER

Upon dealing damage, activate this to immediately destroy all Soak from the damaged Part.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦✦✦✦✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
One of the Dragon Buddhas is known as Huangloong—a name reserved for the Dragon Kings. It was the fabled Huangloong of the Nail of Heaven, who taught this murderous technique said to bring down the highest of the deities of the ancient Celestial Feudalist Aristocracy, now converted into the Heavenly Bourgeoisie.

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹; POLEARM OR DAGGER

When the Cultivator deals damage to the target's Torso, she may activate this to suddenly infuse the weapon with the Heaven-Scourging Sidhi to send herself, the weapon, and the target hurtling down to earth. For every 2m descended by the target, deal another +1 damage, up to 5. Upon striking the earth, the target suffers KNOCKDOWN and 2 true damage to all Parts.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦✦✦✦✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
Strike true, and bring heaven down to earth.

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦✦✦✦

The Dracontine KILLS THE BUDDHA against anything that is higher than her by at least 1m, this deals +1 weapon damage and inflicts KNOCKDOWN, knocking the target out of the air. If they're Juggled, this STUNS for 3s as well.

system.description:
Like a pistol, throw a hand out and summon a shard of annihilation.

The Eschatonian Sect was constructed by the Scarlet Cadre. Those who followed the Metteya Scriptures, the Future Enlightened One, who will turn the Wheel, and face the world back to the Law.

Emanate a slash of pure annihilative vajra energy, burgeoning from one's cacotopic soul. Crafted by the 8-Armed Asura, an Annihilation Cult who followed the Sword Law. They believed that focusing eskatonic sidhi into an information-cutting blade is the first step to Enlightenment. They believed that in the destruction can one find love.

The Commission of Battle Magick received the consent of oppressed masters everywhere to craft a revolutionary battle magick, from the depths of sea caves to the peaks of mountain retreats.

All within suffer [BLACK SORCERY] blast damage and if they're wearing anything conductive they're Stunned for 6 ticks.

A magick where you take away the heat in a particular locality to accelerate entropy.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦

MANTRA: TEGUS VARAM | MUDRA: Heaven → Stillness → Intent CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CHARGE TIME: 7 EFFECT: Flash-freeze a point within 20m, summoning a 3m tall and wide pillar of ice. Any entity that fails to avoid it (against Demand [BLACK SORCERY - 1, min. 1]) is encased in the pillar of ice, frozen. The Pillar has 30DR and melts at the usual rate.

The emulation of the poltergeist. A very popular and very feared black sorcery magick.

MANTRA: TA BI | MUDRA: Dragon -> Wisdom CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CHARGE TIME: 3 EFFECT: Violently knockback an entity within 10m that can be seen up to [3 + BLACK SORCERY].

They dance on the knife’s edge: most traitor Eschatonians become jobbers for the high military. for HAECO or for Amatsu. The communist party needs their explosive power the most.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦✦

Even the vaunted Batara Kala, an ancient Deity who has ascended to one of the Deepest Heavens returned to teach his Carving Magick.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

MANTRA: RIPOR VARAM MUDRA: Heaven → Man → Earth → Noose CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CHARGE TIME: 8 EFFECT: Overload neurons on all hostiles within a 10m radius. All must succeed on a Demand [BLACK SORCERY + 1] Mind + Stillness Check or lose 3 Morale immediately.

A manifestation of the Buddha Metteya, and her return heralds the final End of a current World Order and the establishment of a new World Order that is beneficial for the Wretched of the Earth, so that Hingsajagra might finally ascend to the next stage of civilization. To the teachings of the Eschaton, the end is nothing but the Trichiliocosm’s movement to its next incarnation.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

The Caster can bring the Omniverse’s Heat Death to the present and obliterate all illusion of time: when she Casts Magick, she can use MAHAKALI to immediately cast it, without needing to make Checks.

A more fine tuned version of the poltergeist emulation. This one is pure telekinetic prowess, wielding nothing but the mind. The annihilation of stasis.

Summon a lance of pure annihilative vajra energy that explodes in a burst of thermobaric ruination.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹✹✹

Mantra: SAGUNA | Mudra: Heaven → Thunderbolt CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CHARGE TIME: 12 EFFECT: The caster can choose a point she can see. She sends a vajra arrow to that area, exploding as it touches any nongas point. When it explodes, it expands into a 50m radius, and deals [BLACK SORCERY + 2] blast damage to all Parts of all entities within. Afterwards, a Part must be Cleaved from the caster, unless she is touching another person. She can transfer the Cleaving to the other person.

The Eschatonian cuts herself out of reality for a moment, apparating again in a different location through advanced entanglement principles.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

Mantra: PARATITYA WARAM Mudra: Heaven → Wheel → Ego- Cutting → Intent → Violence CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CHARGE TIME: 4 EFFECT: The caster teleports up to x2 her 2 x [MIND + BLACK SORCERY] in meters. Beyond that, there’s a 1-in-6 chance of her not appearing for 2d6 days instead. // [+✹] Force this teleportation upon another instead as an opposed Mind + BLACK SORCERY vs Heart + Stillness Check. Should the caster win, she immediately teleports them the distance. Should she lose, only half, and the target chooses where to reappear.
system.mudra: Heaven → Wheel → Ego- Cutting → Intent → Violence

system.description:
We are the oldest continuous cultivation tradition in the Utter Islands, predating even the Enlightened One. Our roots lie in the ancient pyre-sages of Razru, who first discovered that the human body contained a microcosmic furnace—the Lower Cauldron—that could refine ambient Sidhi into pills.

License: Internal Elixir ✦

Needs: ✹

Demand 2 | Duration 1 day Goal 8 | Limit 4 Must be done in an alchemy laboratory or refinery. Upon accomplishing the Project, the wielder must burn the needed Flame. She can make one of the following Pills: 0.01 KG DELUXE ITEM N/A HEALING PILL When ingested, heal 2 HP from a damaged Part. 0.01 KG DELUXE ITEM N/A ANTIDOTE PILL When ingested, immediately removes an ongoing poison from one's system. 0.01 KG DELUXE ITEM N/A FULFILNESS PILL When ingested, immediately removes the need for food for [INTERNAL ELIXIR] days. 0.01 KG DELUXE ITEM N/A FIREBALL PILL Can be set on fire. It turns into a floating fireball that orbits the user for up to [INTERNAL ELIXIR] minutes.

Imbue a pill with Sidhi and toss it.

License: Internal Elixir ✦

Needs: ✹

KILL THE BUDDHA with a Pill in the Inventory, having the same statistics as a LAUNCHER. Deals [FAC+1] pierce damage unless it's a Healing Pill, in which case it will heal its stated amount. Depending on the type of pill a secondary effect might happen: poison, smoke, flash or explosive (2m radius fulmination).

To be one with the Pure Movement of the World is to know all of its esoteric angles.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

As long as the Flame is installed, the Cultivator can see up to 100m of her, though she only sees anything behind obstructing objects as heat signatures. This prevents her from being Ambushed.

The cicada spends years underground to leave its body behind. What is immortality if not the acceptance of death?

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦

Needs: ✹

Activate this to molt at any point, ending (choose one): Bleeding, Aflame, Control to a Part, or Stun, then dash [3 + INTERNAL ELIXIR] meters. This movement ignores KNOCKDOWN and JUGGLED. The Cultivator leaves behind a husk of dead skin and cooling Sidhi in the place you stood. It lasts 6 ticks and has 3 Durability. The first hostile action aimed at you after you molt is spent on the husk instead.

Outer Alchemy is chemistry. The practice of concocting, boiling, forging, and crafting pills, elixirs, and other alchemical reagents and items to strengthen one’s body in an attempt to attain immortality.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

Demand 3 | Duration 1 hour | Goal 10 | Limit 5 This is a project to be done within an alchemy laboratory or refinery. Upon accomplishing the Project, the wielder must burn the needed Flame. On success, she can transmute various nonmagical materials into other non-magical materials of similar mass and complexity, though the object cannot be larger than her. Up to 50kg.This cannot create gold, silver, any highly complex element or mineral or any esoteric substance.

Yaji not only means the ideological representation of “Man” but also means “Way” of things. When a thing is yaji, that thing is symmetric and in line with the Supreme Principle, the ultimate suchness of all things. Some consider it as Heaven, or Tian. Others call it Buddha Nature. Others call it “God.”

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦

Needs: —

The Fangshi meditates to turn her whole body into a furnace. She can now refine Fangshi Pills and Elixirs without a laboratory, just her own hands, though she still needs the appropriate materials. More importantly, she can transmute her very own hands and skin, allowing her to summon fire and winds to strike with her Empty Hand, giving her Empty Hand REACH 2 and letting it deal blast damage.

It is from Internal Alchemy that one realizes a profound truth: that the soul is not separate from the Body. In fact, it arises from the Body. With this body, you will break down the gates of heaven and steal Enlightenment from the mouths of Immortals.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

Summon a 3m long shield within 2m of the Cultivator. The Shield has [10 x INTERNAL ELIXIR] dr and cannot be moved through by enemies but can by allies. It is also translucent, made purely of Barrier Sidhi. Anyone behind the Shield is completely safe behind it—all attacks hit the semispherical shield. Only those partially behind it get to use it as just Cover.

By attaining immortality one achieves physical harmony with The Yaji, as opposed to the mental harmony of the other practices.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

Demand 3 | Duration 3 hours | Goal 12 | Limit 6 This is a project to be done within an alchemy laboratory or refinery, with the appropriate equipment and with at least 1,000mag and spirit herbs. Upon accomplishing the Project, the wielder must burn the needed Flame. To create the one of the following Elixirs: 0.50 KG PRESTIGE ITEM N/A DISGUISE ELIXIR Ingesting this immediately changes one part about the ingester's face or voice. Someone who knows her before or is exceptionally observant can still see through it. 0.50 KG PRESTIGE ITEM N/A THUNDERBOLT ELIXIR Ingesting this grants the user +1 WIT and +1 MOT for 24 hours. This effect does not stack. The ingester then suffers 3 true damage to the torso. 0.50 KG PRESTIGE ITEM N/A INFERNO ELIXIR After ingesting, for 3 hours, the drinker becomes immune to fire and can control and produce flame from her hands. This allows her to set people aflame as well as deal [HRT] blast damage if she attacks with these flames that can be fired up to 10m from her.

Deep within a Sentient Being’s subtlest body is the Heart of Beast, chained not by Reason but by Ignorance. The deepest infernal Vajra Beast within is nothing but Omniscience as well. Omnipotence? Omniscience? Both are Empty. Both are Luminiscent Enlightened Nature.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹; Empty Hand

Deal blast damage to the Torso and force the target's Subtle Body out of their physical body. This astral body is pushed back 10m. Anything that happens to the astral body happens to the physical body. The physical body needs to physically return to the astral body to refuse. While the Soul is out, the target suffers -2 MND.
system.tags: Fangshi, Internal Elixir, ✦✦✦✦, Technick, Empty Hand

system.description:
The apex fire, burning soul and karma.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

While in Samadhi, summon a fire that burns either a single thing or creature within 30m or all within a 10m long, 5m wide cone. Those that fail to get out of the way or avoid it immediately suffer an Inferno that cannot be removed and deals [INTERNAL ELIXIR] damage.

There are no words to describe the Yaji. And so I will describe everything else, so that the emptiness may be its shape.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹

At any time, activate ACTION-NON-ACTION to make the Cultivator or any entity she can see perform any Action immediately.

The Ultramystics call us reactionaries because we do not march with the masses. The Techgnostics call us primitives because we do not replace our flesh with brass. But we are the ones who have actually become immortal—not through the exploitation of spirits, not through the consumption of others' cultivation, but through the perfect refinement of the self.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

The Cultivator touches the earth and knows the current state of the earth up to a 50m radius of her. She knows if there's anyone touching the earth and what happened up to 3 nights ago. For the next hour, anything she does within this 50m radius area has +2 dice. She can extend this knowledge and benefit to any number of entities within 15m of her.

To strengthen the soul is to attain divinity. To touch the infernal Beast within is to be closer to enlightenment than any Ialdabaoth or Mara. This once cracked Sokana, the closest orbital heaven, during the Second World Revolution, and caused all orbital heavens thereafter to be built further into the Akasha.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹

Demand 5 | Duration 5 hours | Goal 12 | Limit 6 Needs a Dragon Tooth, Dragon Eye, and Dragon Tongue along with 10,000mag. Upon accomplishing the Project, the wielder must burn the needed Flame. To create the Five Dragons Pill: 0.50 KG PRESTIGE ITEM N/A FIVE DRAGONS PILL The ingester takes 3 true damage to her Head. Then she can manipulate, control, and shape earth, fire, lightning or water within 20m that she can see. This cannot be larger than a waterfall nor a large 5 meter wide and 20 meter tall pillar. If used to attack, it deals [crafter's INTERNAL ELIXIR] blast damage along with any other additional environmental effect.

Sublime archers even in the age of guns, they have become impenetrable with their ability to infuse attacks with penetrating Sidhi.

License: Solar Bow ✦

Needs: ✹

Upon firing an arrow, the Cultivator can activate this to propel it with a fulmination of Bowman Sidhi. It goes in a straight line up to 30m long and goes straight through most things that it hits.

Developed by the first master of Dragonfly Cutting, Ingkan. Ingkan teaches to be endlessly and effervescently resourceful.

License: Solar Bow ✦

Needs: —

As long as this is Internalized, the Cultivator now does not need AMMO to fire Bow, Crossbow, or Launcher Attacks, as she uses anything lighter than 0.25kg (a mote of dust, a falling flower petal, a piece of her sidhi, a ray of light) as a damaging projectile.

Developed by the first master of Dragonfly Cutting, Ingkan. Ingkan teaches to be endlessly and effervescently resourceful.

License: Solar Bow ✦

Needs: ✹ or ✹✹

Upon firing an arrow, burn the Flame to split it in half—the second arrow hits a random Part. Burn an extra Flame to split it into three arrows and have them converge into a single Part.

The Hamayumi deals in expunging evil, as it means “Evil Purging Bow.”

License: Solar Bow ✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

Upon firing an arrow, activate this to strengthen it with Evil Purging Sidhi. All malevolent INTRA-INT entities (ghosts, demons, Black Nectar infected, Marionette Puppets, black sorcery creations, and so on) suffer double damage from this arrow.

The first technique taught to all Dragonfly Cutters. Gain control over the battlefield through controlled breathing and sharp eyesight.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

The Cultivator sinks into SINGLE POINT meditation after dealing damage to a single point on an object or a part on an enemy to lock in on that point. While meditating, all her arrow shots magnetize automatically to the locked in point.

Sashi the First Hunter invented this technique at the request of her student. The student was bloodthirsty but righteous, killing a peaceful demon village.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦

Needs: ❂; bow, crossbow, longgun

Choose a target within weapon range. Mark their very information into the mind's eye. The target becomes a valid target for any weapon even without line of sight, behind cover, and so on. All damage against this target gains +1. But the target can sense the Devil-Marker's direction.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, longgun

system.description:
Shoot a superprecise shot, informed by attunement to the Flow, and pin down an enemy.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹; bow, crossbow, longgun

Pin a target's clothing or limb (deal damage) to a wall or floor, counting as Control over that Limb. The Cultivator may install +❂ to make that projectile impossible to pull out without a successful Demand [SOLAR BOW] Physique + Thews and Sinews Check.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, longgun

system.description:
It is difficult to explain the concept of Yaji within the Cosmic Signifier. It can be translated as “Virtue” or as “Way” or as “Path” or as “Rightness.” Yaji is supposed to be unknowable: the act of doing something in accordance with the Yaji will express itself with the feeling of utmost rightness, of feeling like you are doing something right. This feeling is immanent within all beings, no matter the reincarnation.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹; bow, crossbow, longgun

Activate this at any point to deal damage to a chosen target (random Part if a lifeform) within wielded weapon's range.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, longgun

system.description:
The ancient archery art of SOLAR BOW partially grew out of the primeval Cutting Dragonfly Wings bow art: once the prime archery art of the Revolutionary Army across the world, it has since become a zealously guarded secret to keep the knowledges safe from the reactionary forces of the United Union.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹; bow, crossbow, longgun

Fire a single arrow into the air and it splits into a hundred arrows through Arrow Sidhi. It falls upon a point within 20m that expands to a 3m wide radius fulmination. Those that fail to dodge it or get out of the fulmination suffer weapon damage to two random parts.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, longgun

system.description:
Attune with the All of Nature. A single flow.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂; bow, crossbow, longgun

Spend time unmoving and then install this Flame. While installed, the Cultivator cannot move, but they become completely invisible and untrackable by mundane means until they make considerable action that produces large amounts of sound.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, longgun

system.description:
Sects that are friendly with the Heaven Pillar are given leniency and allowed to learn the secret arts. The Revolutionary Army destroyed them when they tried to break off, attempting to create their own ethnostate. The Houyi have saved their arts and integrated them into their own.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹; bow, crossbow, longgun

The Cultvator may activate this when firing a ranged KILL THE BUDDHA with a non-[AUTO] weapon, that the Cultivator has aimed with for at least 2 ticks. This converts all extra dice from the aiming into Strikes.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, longgun

system.description:
Kaburas of the Gleaming Dark invented this technique to better serve his job as a Magister for Soreh. For his penance after the Second World Revolution, he teaches it to all that wish, provided they will kill an Imperial or Capitalist. The Contemplatives of Dagger Forest Mountain learned to be possessed by the rapidity of Non-Thought, moving faster to defeat the Dragonfly God of Quickness.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹✹✹; bow, crossbow, launcher, longgun

The Cultivator's weapon explodes with coruscating Sun-Shattering Sidhi, and she commits violence. The range of this attack is infinite, as long as she can see or knows where the target is. Upon dealing damage to any Part, she may convert all her dice that came up as 4+ into +1 damage on that instance of Damage.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦✦✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, launcher, longgun

system.description:
Immanents are always in a half-trance state that lets them channel Pure White Sidhi to be able to better sublate wounds into healed fragments.

License: White Sorcery ✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA: ALMA MUDRA: Heaven → Wisdom CHECK: HRT + WHITE SORCERY CHARGE TIME: 6 EFFECT: Heal a single Part within 10m by [WHITE SORCERY] HP. Staunch Bleeding originating from that Part and sterilize its open wounds. Embedded objects remain and may need removal before the wound can safely close.

To heal more than one requires a heart that is not pure. Compassion does not denote purity. It denotes courage and wisdom. It denotes a soul that has been blackened but still insists on doing good. This is the truth of sublation.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

MANTRA: AL MA KSHE TRA MUDRA: Heaven → Wisdom → Dragon CHECK: HRT + WHITE SORCERY CHARGE TIME: 12 EFFECT: Sublate and superposition: choose one target in 10m. Swap one Part with them magickally: the target's R Arm becomes the caster's R Arm, and so on. This only swaps the healthiness of a Part, not what its holding, not what its wearing. Any magick effects go with the swap, however.

Immanents are often the closest thing to "religious figures" in their particular locales. They are sometimes Vicars of the Kingdom of Heaven, or Bishops of the Merkabahn Church, or Dialecticians of the 10,000 Dragons.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

MANTRA: ARU MA NA MUDRA: Heaven → Wisdom → Sword → Heaven CHECK: HRT + WHITE SORCERY CHARGE TIME: 18 EFFECT: Choose a point within 20m. All damaged entities within a 3m radius from it heal all their Parts by [WHITE SORCERY] HP.

The Immanents became protectors. They spread their knowledges with other places—particularly, Selorong synthesized their Arts with their own Soul Herald practices, creating the new Celestial Restoration Art that can be taught by all, without the need for an innate healing spirit to choose you.

License: White Sorcery ✦

Needs: ❂

MANTRA: BE DZRA MUDRA: Heaven → Earth → Violence CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CHARGE TIME: 8 EFFECT: Choose someone or something within 12m. They gain [WHITE SORCERY] Barrier to up to 2 Parts. Barrier is temporary HP to those Parts and are reduced before normal HP, and works with Soak. Cannot stack.

Esrafyl is the celestine of healing, protection, and medicine. Sometimes considered a deity. Othertimes considered just a registry angel. He is a powerful entity all the same that sides clandestinely with the Working Class.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA: ES RA FYL I AN MUDRA: Wisdom → Sword CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CHARGE TIME: 3 EFFECT: The Cultivator directs their compassion upon someone she can see. She can alleviate any Aflame, Stun, or Winded from them.

Immanents entangle with various angelic entities in a bid to wield the inherent dialectic of the world. So as the Man negates God, so does the Angel negate man. The Immanents are not strangers to freaky occultic ritual, and much less so are they strangers to invoking the various angels that drift across the Heavens. The Astral Seraphic Sidhi of Oryeline burns to purge his allies of venom.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

MANTRA: OR YE LINE MUDRA: Heaven → Thunderbolt CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CHARGE TIME: 8 (Ritual: 1 hour) EFFECT: The Cultivator magickally negates the black thread of venom: one entity she can touch is cured of any single disease or poison.

Immanents tap even upon the imagery of healing buddhas, of humans that have attained enlightenment, to sublate all things.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA: RE PANG MUDRA: Wisdom CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CHARGE TIME: 3 EFFECT: The target can immediately dispel a magick she has identified as with countermagick. She can hold this countermagick after casting it, but she can only hold one Hallowed Dispellation at a time.

"Holiness and sacrality are not qualities of reality but the imposition of reason. Anything can become Divine, for everything is Divine and Not- Divine." — Georg of the Thothian Ajna

License: White Sorcery ✦

Needs: ❂❂

MANTRA: JI MUDRA: Heaven → Wisdom → Violence CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CHARGE TIME: 10 EFFECT: A stationary 5m radius centered where cast for as long as the Flame is installed: four columns emerge from the world’s reflection. Between them, a roof assembles itself from white cloud and vermilion beams. This place is a consecrated temple. Dust refuses to cross the threshold. Ordinary rain parts around the eaves. Surfaces become sterile beneath light cast by lamps that contain no flame. Succor and Triage Checks gain +2 dice within. With bedding and adequate food, the formation counts as a proper place of rest for healing. It creates no supplies and offers no barrier to weapons.

The Immanents eventually became known as the Divine Hand of the Mountains when they were forced to flee into the mountains after the victory of the Heavenly Bourgeoisie. They compiled all their learnings, magicks, technicks, and inscribed them upon imperishable stone. Then, they kept it within hidden soul caves, sealed by powerful magicks.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦

Needs: ✹

The Cultivator reduces a long operation or medical treatment to seconds, at a rate of 1 hour into 1 minute.

The Celestial Healers became much wanted healers in the Revolutions. There was never a cadre without them. They did this because they knew—the day of the Red Sun was soon.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

MANTRA: MULAK LANTA MUDRA: Heaven → Earth → Heat CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CHARGE TIME: 12 EFFECT: The Cultivator must touch someone and heal all HP to that part. If a Cleaved limb can be attached to that Part, this Magick can heal and resuture that limb back to full HP.

Magick Healing targets Health—that is to say, the Inner Sidhi. The Life Force of a person. It does not regrow lost limbs or impaired functions, only the vivacity of a person. And so, surgeons, prostheticians, and other medical professionals are still required for more specific healing jobs.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹✹✹ + 1 Sidhi Stage from the caster

MANTRA ING KUNG MUDRA HIGH CEREMONY CHECK HRT + WHITE SORCERY CHARGE TIME 33 (RITUAL: 8 HOURS) EFFECT: The Immanent chooses someone she loves and brings him back from the brink of death, as long as it hasn’t been 24 hours and she can touch him skin to skin or bone to bone. They are healed to full HP, though they do not reconstitute any lost limbs. While in Samadhi, the Ing Kung Immanent can now focus her Compassion Sidhi into a burning halo. She must burn 4 Flame and channel at least 6 hours (lasts even when Samadhi ends), without moving, to expunge a single area within 10m of rot and entropy and fill it once again with flourishing life, at the prime of its life. Any sentient beings and objects within this area are cleansed of any viruses and diseases and are healed of all Wounds. Any demonic taint or corruptive Sidhi is vaporized, unless the corruptive Sidhi is too strong, in which case it is revealed instead.

The Distant Stars are all Archons—servants of the Cosmic Chakravartins. All the stars are other heavens. They are watching us.

License: Astral ✦

Needs: ✹

Every night, when the sky is clear and she can see at least some stars, she can cast a d6 to glean the estrellian entanglements. Her and the rest of her Party gain the following status until dusk of the next day. 1 The Lotus. +1 Beast Shrine. 2 The Spear. +1 Concrete Analysis. 3 The Mountain. +1 Adamance. 4 The Spire. +1 Thews and Sinews. 5 The Ewer. +1 Stillness. 6 The Ox. +1 Manual Labor.

Most common battle magick used by the military employed by most Spheres. Drawing power from one's self is difficult, drawing power from the Stars through Sidhic Entanglement Ritual Algorithm is easier.

License: Astral ✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA A TA RA MUDRA Heaven → Sword CHECK HEART + ASTRAL CHARGE TIME 3 EFFECT Like a gun, shoot a needle of blitzing starlight: deal [ASTRAL] blast damage to someone in 30m.

Spacetime's curvature is what we call gravity, and all spacetime curves around massive things.

License: Astral ✦✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA BA LA NI MUDRA Heaven → Earth CHECK HEART + ASTRAL CHARGE TIME: 3 EFFECT Choose two things within 20m. They are pulled up to [10 - KG] meters to each other. If movement is negative, that thing cannot be moved.

Summon a smoldering star seed into reality, pulling from the power of the stars.

License: Astral ✦✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA RA DIT YA MUDRA Heaven → Thunderbolt CHECK HEART + ASTRAL CHARGE TIME 6 EFFECT A smoldering starseed erupts into being within a 20m point. Any entity within 1m of it is pulled into it, inflicting 1 blast damage to it and then pushing them 5 meters away. The starseed moves 1m per second.

Mark two entities and they are forced to keep at a constant distance.

License: Astral ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

MANTRA KAR TI KA MUDRA Heaven → Sword CHECK HEART + ASTRAL CHARGE TIME 6 EFFECT Choose two entities or objects that the Cultivator can see within 50m. Once both are marked, they can never come closer to each other. If one of them comes at least 1m closer to the other, the other is pushed back the same distance.

"All things follow the curvature of the stars. This doctrine is known as the Starlight Curve." — Jyotisha Ashtin Viagan

License: Astral ✦✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA AWANG MUDRA Heaven → Wisdom CHECK HEART + ASTRAL CHARGE TIME 8 EFFECT The Cultivator reaches out and changes the curvature of spacetime to forcibly move another entity or creature in any direction up to [5 x ASTRAL] meters.

One finds the secrets of spacetime within the stars. This is one of the three Exalted Magicks of the Jyotisha Sect: it slows the movement of a single entity.

License: Astral ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

MANTRA SAN XING FU MUDRA Heaven → Man → Earth CHECK HRT + ASTRAL CHARGE TIME 12 EFFECT The Cultivator holds the spacetime field around someone or something within 20 meters: that target's READY is pushed back by 3 ticks as long as the Flame is installed, that thing is slowed: they gain +3 to Speed, -2 to Basic Move, and forced movements for them is halved as well. For objects, their current velocity is immediately halved.

Meteors are thermonuclear attempts to destroy us, but the deities that live in our heavens—in those transdimensional orbital realms—constantly protect us.

License: Astral ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

MANTRA RE SHIN GU KA MUDRA Heaven → Thunderbolt CHECK HRT + ASTRAL CHARGE TIME 12 EFFECT The Cultivator summons an exploding meteor hammer of celestial force within 30m. All within 10m suffer [ASTRAL + 1] blast damage and suffer an inferno to all parts.

The greatest of Jyotisha study the intricate spacetime weave, the flux of gravity and spacetime.

License: Astral ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA A KA SHA MUDRA Heaven → Sword CHECK HRT + ASTRAL CHARGE TIME 6 EFFECT The Cultivator reaches out to an entity or item within 20m and immediately teleports them to a different point within [5 x ASTRAL] meters of the original point that she can see.

One finds the secrets of spacetime within the stars. This is one of the three Exalted Magicks of the Jyotisha Sect.

License: Astral ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

MANTRA SAN XING LU MUDRA Earth → Man → Heaven CHECK HRT + ASTRAL CHARGE TIME 12 EFFECT The Cultivator quickens the spacetime field around someone or something within 20 meters: that person's next Ready is quickened 2 Ticks earlier as long as the Flame is installed, and then they gain doubled Move and -2 Speed. system.description:
You must learn how to hold two things at once in your mind to be able to sublate them. That's the point of dialectics after all. “Watch his wrist,” said Kafeng. “See where thy sword may go when he lifts it.”

License: Sword Dialectics ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹/✹✹✹/✹✹✹✹ ; SWORDS or SABERS

Upon dealing damage, the Sword Dialectics Cultivator may activate Empu Sword Possibility to immediately explode the cuts into 2/3/4 cuts that damage random parts each (instead of just one instance of damage). She can also use this when her KILL THE BUDDHA is Blocked.
system.tags: Sword Dialectician, Sword Dialectics, ✦✦✦, Technick, SWORDS or SABERS

items.name: Abolish the Present State of Things

system.description:
“Where shall I cut him, master?” “Why cut him? ’Tis the blow thou wouldst end.” The fabled Ultimate Sword Art is the art of Cutting Ego—destroying the cause for Violence before Violence even arises.

License: Sword Dialectics ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹ ; SWORDS or SABERS

When an opponent within weapon reach declares any damaging action, the Sword Dialectics Cultivator may immediately activate this to cancel that Action (spending it) and KILL THE BUDDHA against them.
system.tags: Sword Dialectician, Sword Dialectics, ✦✦✦, Technick, SWORDS or SABERS

system.description:
The Sword Dialecticians were properly assembled after Badrapan, the Herculean Shield of Dattreya Wairini, asked the retired Swordmaster Femon Antang Kabornei—a fellow Masangwanism Student—to teach his style that he had been strengthening this entire time. He agreed eventually, knowing that in the future the Revolution would need an art that could match the guns of Reaction.

License: Sword Dialectics ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹ ; SWORDS or SABERS

The Sword Dialectics Cultivator unleashes a hundred handed sphere of ten thousand cuts within 5m—all chosen entities within 2m are pulled in as space is cut into pieces and then deal weapon damage to three different Parts of each entitiy within. Roll the random part once for all.
system.tags: Sword Dialectician, Sword Dialectics, ✦✦✦✦, Technick, SWORDS or SABERS

system.description:
Femon Antang Kaburnei was one of the students of the Mahakala Sword Satan Kriyang Tambuhan, who before the Second World Revolution sought to bring together the disparate martial arts of Selorong (which included Insular Selorong). Kriyang Tambuhan did not have the words for it, but he expressed a form of fighting that was the purest form of dialectics. When he was called to fight in the Second World Revolution, it was he that created the third License.

License: Sword Dialectics ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂❂ ; SWORDS or SABERS

MANTRA: PINAKA KALI | MUDRA: SWORD CHECK: HRT + SWORD DIALECTICS CHARGE TIME: 8 The Cultivator lets go of her weapon and it floats beside her. It gains a life of its own and can Fly up to 10m/s as its movement. It has the same CORES as the Cultivator, but has no CULTIVATIONS other then the Cultivator's SWORD DIALECTICS. Its Speed is PHYS + WIT + SWORD DIALECTICS. The Sword can KILL THE BUDDHA. Should the Sword move into its Cultivator and vice versa, the Cultivator can ride on the Sword like a surfboard, moving with the Sword, using the Sword's Movement speed.
system.tags: Sword Dialectician, Sword Dialectics, ✦✦✦✦✦, Magick, SWORDS or SABERS

system.description:
Memorize all the possible cuts, and choose which to negate. Kafeng Masangwa’s daughter, Reni Tirakadiz, was the one that finished the last techniques of her Red Sword Manual. When she finished it, both her arms fell off her sockets, and she became blinded.

License: Sword Dialectics ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹... ; SWORDS or SABERS

Activate upon before a KILL THE BUDDHA. For each Flame burnt, immediately choose 1 die in the dice pool and set it to a Strike instead of rolling.
system.tags: Sword Dialectician, Sword Dialectics, ✦✦✦✦✦, Technick, SWORDS or SABERS

system.description:
Kafeng Masangwa was a consummate swordmaiden—defeated only by the Invincible Blade Princess. And even then, she had the stronger resolve.

License: Sword Dialectics ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹ ; SWORDS or SABERS

The Cultivator can activate this to KILL THE BUDDHA from up to 10m away with her blades, sending out beams of SWORD SIDHI from her weapon. When in the middle of a KILL THE BUDDHA, should she need extra range to hit a farther target (perhaps a target who has moved out of range), she can activate SUNDANG SAMAYIL to send a Sword Beam to that target, cutting at the original target. She can use this upon dealing damage to extend the damage in a 3m long line across the original cut damage, dealing the damage to a random part.
system.tags: Sword Dialectician, Sword Dialectics, ✦✦✦✦✦, Technick, SWORDS or SABERS

system.description:
We do not worship the Machine God Ziben. We are Its rivals. The spawn heretical. We believe that Ziben is the corrupted form of the Machine Eternal—a God of Capital that exploits workers by making them machines for another’s profit. The Machine God is not the enemy—reaction is.

License: Techgnosis ✦

Needs: ❂

While isntalled, a manifested diagram of a Third Arm erupts from a spot, where it acts as a Third Arm and can be attacked, sharing HP with her other Arms.

The Intramechanical Sheathe is a synthetic, thaumaturgical marvel that wraps perfectly to the shape of the wearer and grants them a sleek, technosorcerous look. The Sheathe generates a cloud of femtobots that enfold items into a pocket subspace in between dimensional slices.

License: Techgnosis ✦

Needs: ❂❂

The Cultivator can store items as Akashic Imprints, up to TECHGNOSIS x 5 kg, outside the Cultivator's Carry Limit. Retrieval takes a second. Uninstalling dumps everything at her feet. The item becomes a unique stored Imprint: it cannot simultaneously remain outside, be copied into additional objects, or be downloaded by ordinary file access.

We must seize the machine. Turn the body into the technoshrine. Become a Digital Devil reveling in Self- Sorcery.

License: Techgnosis ✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

The Cultivator can use this to see through any camera, screen, or sensor within 100m, with thermal and low-light vision. Searching takes 1 minute per 30 sq/m, and darkness penalties don’t apply. Grants live observation only; archived footage, administrative commands, and connected systems require separate access. The Cultivator's readied handgun, longgun, bow, or crossbow answers to her Ghost. She can target anything a linked camera, drone, or lens sees, and Cover penalties from that vantage are halved. The weapon must still be in range. She can also make this attack with TECHGNOSIS.

It is said that the Black Deity Metom formed the shapes of humanity today. To the extent that this is true is hotly debated. But many say it was Metom that shared both Machinery and helped establish the INTRAJALA upon the sea of SIDHI.

License: Techgnosis ✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

MANTRA: MA TAN USOSHI MUDRA: Dragon -> Wisdom CHECK: MND + TECHGNOSIS CHARGE TIME: 6 EFFECT: The caster temporarily inscribes an accelerated model of the caster’s movement over her Microcosmic Orbit: she gains +1 to Basic Move and Speed for as long as its installed. When uninstalled, she immediately moves in a burst of speed [2 + TECHGNOSIS] meters forward in any direction.

Named after the Devil that granted Humanity the gift of Knowledge, so that we may be as Gods. The Tree of Life is nothing but an Intarjala Terminal. God is nothing but an Omni-Mind.

License: Techgnosis ✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

MANTRA: IN HA THOTH MUDRA: HEAVEN -> SWORD -> DRAGON CHECK: Mind + TECHGNOSIS CHARGE TIME: 6 EFFECT: The caster may project their Consciousness into any machine, controlling it remotely, within 100m. She can use this to also move tools and technology with her mind.

Techgnostics created the bastard ability to project holo-projections straight into the retinas of unsuspecting passerbys.

License: Techgnosis ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA: SA KAN NO | MUDRA: SHIELD -> THUNDERBOLT -> INTENT CHECK: Mind + TECHGNOSIS CHARGE TIME: 8 EFFECT: Any entity within 30m the caster can see has its senses plagued by informational demons and virtual devils, STUNNING them for 3 secs and reducing their Morale by 1. Higher or equal Sidhi entities can struggle against this with an opposed MND + TECHGNOSIS vs HRT + CYBERNETIC HARUSPEX check.

The ability to project holographic imagery is considered Thaumaturgical: that is, magitech. The highest and most bleeding edge of all technology. Through Holoprojection, anyone can be a Wizard or a Cultivator.

License: Techgnosis ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

MANTRA: PRANYA HO LO MUDRA: LOTUS -> VIOLENCE CHECK: Mind + TECHGNOSIS CHARGE TIME: 8 EFFECT: A point within 30m explodes into a 5m wide radius of partially material Akashic reconstruction terrain derived from woven Light Sidhi and manifested sutra inscriptions. It can look like anything provided it looks like it can be entered. The terrain is Difficult and provides Cover for entities outside from entities within and vice versa. All hostiles within suffer -1 to all Checks.

Digital Summoners are sometimes called Devil Summoners. They work with Digital Devils most of the time, which are considered Spirits that inhabit the Intrajala, which itself is inextricably bound to the rest of the Universe by the fact that it's impossibly FTL speeds are due to its foundation in Sidhi.

License: Techgnosis ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

MANTRA: KI SHI MUDRA: HEAVEN -> SWORD CHECK: MND + TECHGNOSIS CHARGE TIME: 2 EFFECT: The Techgnostic summons something made up of Digital Sidhi somewhere in her hands or within 2m of her. This cannot be larger than her. It does not have its own consciousness, but works just like its physical counterpart (a digital sword works like a sword) with the caveat that it only has 1 DR. It cannot duplicate stored Flame, living consciousness, or a relic’s unique supernatural powers. Any normal function needing fuel or ammunition still needs it. This cannot be fire, lightning, ice, or any other dynamic force: it must be snapshot of an artificial object.

As Digital Summoners, they know that Digital Devils in truth, supranormal intelligences—or Souls without a Body—that arose from the Sea of Information generated by the Intrajala. They are AGI, to some people. And yet their Souls are not human... so it would be folly to think of them as such...

License: Techgnosis ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

MANTRA: KO TO MUDRA: HEAVEN -> MAN CHECK: MND + TECHGNOSIS CHARGE TIME: 12 (Ritual: 1 day). EFFECT: The caster seeds a Held Attachment through the Intrajala without being present—self-propagating persuasion. This is WRITTEN SOCIAL ENGINEERING, with copies preserving the original Demand. Halve the Mob size penalty, and the Attachment keeps spreading to others who never met you. The recipient resists the mesage once, not once per copy, and it cannot bypass INTRAJALAN seals or invent acess.

"TM, run that back for me, please. Cybertalisman_ 0."

License: Techgnosis ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

MANTRA: REIK HA MUDRA: WISDOM -> THUNDEBROLT CHECK: MND + TECHGNOSIS CHARGE TIME: 15 (Ritual: 1 day). EFFECT: Run a simulation-assisted research as an Experiment source for UNRAVEL HEAVEN’S LAWS. Check MND + TECHGNOSIS vs Demand 3 or higher. Success can upgrade an Assumed premise to Established if it matches the caster's Facts, or exposes a contradiction. It can’t resolve Demand 5+ intramaterial mysteries. Its results derive from supplied Facts and models.

Named after the ancient God of Wisdom and Writing. Specialists at thinking machines and the INTRAJALA. Professional thinking machine engineers and all the weirdofuckery that comes with it. Work and bind Digital Devils, which operate with different consciousnesses from both humans and spirits.

License: Techgnosis ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂❂❂

MANTRA: RA KEE RA THOTH MUDRA: LOTUS -> HEAVEN -> NOOSE CHECK: MND + TECHGNOSIS CHARGE TIME: 20 (Ritual: 3 days). EFFECT: The Techgnostic conjures and prods at a particular item or object and brings to life the nascent potential Consciousness within it. It begins to speak and has memory of its time there. By burning the Flame installed, the Techgnostic can provoke it to Self Sorcery to turn it into a sentient Digital Devil. Doing so, however, might have immediate precautions once the Digital Devil becomes aware. Its memory is limited to information the object could have registered through its construction or Sidhic traces.

Together, we developed a path of Cultivation that treats the body as the machine-shrine that it is. Replacing flesh with refined Magicite, blood with Black Nectar, and thought with mantracomputation. We were there when the first thinking machines attained Self-Sorcery. We know the secrets to their dyadic mantras.

License: Techgnosis ✦✦✦✦

Needs: —

A bound program-entity now lives in your COMP that has achieved Self-Sorcery. It assists Checks (+2), keeps watch so the caster can’t be easily ambushed, and can cast up to POTENCY 5 Magick for the caster. It talks and can hold its own Attachments.

The most secret of the TECHGNOSTICS' magick. It has a horrifying implication: what is reality but information? Sidhi carries data, after all. But isn't every mote of reality a collapsed state, and thus, an data point?

License: Techgnosis ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂❂; a functioning Terminal or COMP within reach

MANTRA: SU RAT KA WI MUDRA: Heaven → Man → Earth CHECK: MND + TECHGNOSIS CHARGE TIME: 12\ EFFECT: The Cultivator inscribes an Akashic record of the positions of herself and up to [TECHGNOSIS] willing creatures she can see within 20m. Their recorded positions appear as faint, motionless images composed of revolving talisman-script. The record lasts while installed, for up to 10 mins. The Terminal must remain functioning, and each subject must remain within 50m of it to remain recorded. AKASHIC RESTORE [✹] Return one willing recorded subject to their recorded position and facing. Takes 3 Ticks. The subject dissolves into luminous characters and reforms at the recorded location.The destination must contain sufficient unoccupied space and support the subject. If it does not, that restoration cannot be attempted. Restore the subject with their currently worn and carried belongings. A creature they carry is transported only if it is willing. Physical bonds connecting the subject to something left behind prevent restoration unless first broken. he record preserves spatial position, not an earlier bodily state. After a subject is restored, their Akashic Entry is consumed. Each subject may therefore be restored only once per casting. Destroying the Terminal ends the Magick and erases its remaining entries. Ordinary copying of its Information Talismans cannot duplicate the active working.
