system.description:
You have heard the lies. The Ultramystic path is not safe. It is not obedient. It does not require Magicite hoarded in corporate vaults. It requires struggle. It requires the friction of bodies against the machinery of Capital, the heat of collective action.

License: Immortal Science ✦

Needs: ❂

Establish a Consciousness Thread with a willing listener. Through this thread, the Ultramystic can share emotions, coordinate actions, telepathically communicate. As long as this is installed, any action that is coordinated through the Consciousness Thread benefits from +1 dice. This includes coordinating someone to attack.

They call us terrorists. They call us bandits. They call us mountaineers and forest-dwellers and enemies of peace. Peace is the word they use for our silence. We will not be silent. We will not be peaceful. We will be violent, and our violence will be the only honest BLACK SORCERY the Utter Islands have ever heard.

License: Immortal Science ✦

Needs: ❂

The meditation of the Cultivator allows her very words to inflict very real trauma: she wields her words and logic like a weapon. She can KILL THE BUDDHA with MND + IMMORTAL SCIENCE and she she can inflict 1 Morale Loss per Strike she wins with. If the target is already Shattered, start dealing damage like normal to body parts. Her Words and Logic have [10 + MND] meters range.

The pure, unalloyed violence that arises when the wretched of the earth decide they will no longer be wretched.

License: Immortal Science ✦✦

Needs: ✹

The Cultivator must utter a Fact that they know about the present state of the world and also the material conditions of the ones they're fighting. All listening lose 1 Morale and suffer -2 to their next KILL THE BUDDHA Checks.

Everything that will ever happen has been seen in the eyes of the dialectician.

License: Immortal Science ✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

The Cultivator may activate this this to swap places with a single person within sight, pulling intramaterially upon the strands of dialectical entanglement and superposition. The Cultivator may choose the facing of the one swapped with after the fact.

"...material violence must be overthrown by material violence; but theory also becomes a material violence as soon as it has gripped the masses. " — Great Marx Buddha

License: Immortal Science ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

The Cultivator may take time to analyze a location she's in. She rolls MIND + IMMORTAL SCIENCE. For every Strike, she gains THEORY. For any Check, she can spend Theory to buy Strikes for it, 1-for-1. For KILL THE BUDDHA, she can use this to Theory to pay for Hits.

In the Revolutionary Era, the Arch-Revolutionary Kafeng Masangwa attained some modicum of Omniscience by solidifying her materialist doctrine of Scientific Communism. The followers of Masangwa wield the Sword of Dialectics to cut through contradiction and find the ultimate Resolution at the heart of things, which is sublation, which is nonduality.

License: Immortal Science ✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

The Cultivator's logical razor cuts through the propaganda of the enemy. Should she be the target of a successful CHANGE GOD'S MIND attempt, she can activate SCYTHE OF DIALECTICS to immediately reject the attempt, no matter how convincing and no matter what her Attachments say. She can only use this if she has at least 2 or more current Morale.

All deduction is a recursion of reduction. All deduction is the sublation of Contradiction. So deduce, and tell us what you see. The counterbalance to Pessimism of the Intellect. Having accepted the limits of logic, the practitioner now chooses to act. The will, unburdened by the need for perfect certainty, becomes a blazing force.

License: Immortal Science ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

The Cultivator may use this when trying to understand something to immediately gain a proper indispensable Established Premise, even if they have never investigated, as long as they already have another different Established Premise.

A single spark can start a prairie fire.

License: Immortal Science ✦✦

Needs: ✹

When using CHANGE GOD’S MIND on a crowd that can hear and understand them, reduce the Mob Size penalty by 2, to a minimum of 0. Disposition, Attachments, Social Defense, and Persistence apply normally to the people addressed. This does not expand the size categories or remove the need to reach the audience.

Suroso Rangshi, a Communist during the Decades of Carnage, focused on the speech and logical part of the Dialectical Method and created this Technick, an addendum to the Scientific Method that is fused by Revolutionary Alchemical ideas to transmute concepts from one thing to another by way of applying contradictions.

License: Immortal Science ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

The Cultivator and all allies within [FACE x 5]m immediately heals 3 Morale.

It involves collective ingesting of profane substances—sometimes but not always an Elixir of Revolution (made of aborted fetus, semen, menstruation blood, all of past revolutionaries). This is followed by the subsequent cutting of each other, before bathing in a natural hot spring, untouched by Capital.

License: Immortal Science ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

When an Ultramystic enters a new area, she can immediately ask for a local RIGHT-HAND due to the intensely wide interconnecting network of the Communist Party. The RIGHT-HAND is a whole World Being made like a Cultivator. The Right-Hand will fight alongside her and work with her as much as possible. Should the Cultivator die, the player can take on the Right-Hand as a new Cultivator.

"To the present day, all weapons are still an extension of the spear and the shield." — Comrade Yeuhn-ji All things are made up of smaller things. All kings are made strong by their warriors. All warriors are fed by the farmers. In truth, it is the Small that creates the Large. In truth, there can be no Large without the Small. There is no one Great without the Meager. There are no Atoms without Protons. There is no Society without the Human. There is no Bourgeoisie without the Proletariat.

License: Immortal Science ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

When the Cultivator KILLS THE BUDDHA, her and all her allies that join it gain +1 per ally, including herself, to the Check. If she has any ally connected with CONSCIOUSNESS THREAD, she can uninstall the Flame to immediately teleport them to her side so they can join the KILL THE BUDDHA, provided they're within 50m.

THERE IS NO GOD BUT THE PROLETARIAT.

License: Immortal Science ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂❂❂❂

While Installed, as long as an Cultivator's Allies are within 100m of her, she cannot die. If she dies from the violence of an enemy of the Proletariat, she immediately dematerializes and rematerializes adjacent to an ally of her choice. Every death she suffers this way grants her +1 Perversion and +50 XP, and adds +4 to all her Checks for 10 minutes. She then loses this License. If the Ultramystic has a Right Hand, the Ultramystic can choose to die. If she does, the Right Hand gains all her current Licenses and Traits. That Right Hand cannot use this ability.

The Wukongs have perfected the art of patience, becoming like mountains, and challenging all to strike them. Like their name’s sake, their Sidhi are born from spheres of rock.

License: Sage Body ✦

Needs: ❂

After dealing damage, use this to inflict AGGRAVATION on the target. They find it difficult to attack others: they deal -2 damage if the target is not the Wukong. Any Aggravated entity that leaves the melee weapon range of the Cultivator suffers 1 true damage to a random Part.

This is the Ego Beyond Ego. Otherwise known as the God Beyond God. At the core of the Vajra Sutra is nothing but Emptiness. So remember to spit It out.

License: Sage Body ✦✦

Needs: ✹

Activate this at any point when an ally within 15m that the Cultivator can see is the target of a KILL THE BUDDHA to immediately leap next to that ally and perform the KILL THE BUDDHA instead.

By meditating upon interdependence, Wukongs can impossibly swap places with someone they pledge to protect, moving intramaterially.

License: Sage Body ✦

Needs: ❂

The cultivator touches a willing ally and installs the Flame to pledge to their safety. While within 30m of each other, the Wukong can release the installed Flame at any time to immediately swap places with the ally, keeping momnetum and any ongoing actions, if any.

"Nothing in the world is difficult... only the mind makes it so." — Wukong Shi Hou.

License: Sage Body ✦✦

Needs: ❂

While installed, drop into a supernatural wide-stance. The Cultivator's movement is reduced by 1, but she becomes immune to knockback, knockdown, and juggle.

Not just a metaphor. With just an incantation, the Wukongs are able to emulate the actions of the hallowed Bhante, turning into stone and becoming impervious to all things.

License: Sage Body ✦✦

Needs: ✹ + ❂❂

MANTRA: TAMRA SIRSA LOHA PADA MUDRA: SWORD CHECK PHYS + SAGE BODY CHARGE TIME: 2 EFFECT: The Cultivator suddenly turns her body into solid rock: she becomes impervious to all damage and cannot be moved and effectively turns into terrain However, she also cannot do anything, cannot move, and is effectively asleep. She can end the Magick at any time by releasing the Flame. Any entity that strikes her solid rock form must succeed on a DEMAND 2 PHYS + ADAMANCE Check or become STUNNED for 6 seconds.

The Wukong Sect was established to create a Cultivator that could raid the Orbital Heavens and steal away their the vaunted Peaches of Immortality which held immense amounts of Sidhi within them. Huowang means Monkey King.

License: Sage Body ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹ + ❂❂

MANTRA: SAMA DHI SKAN DHA MUDRA: DRAGON CHECK HRT + SAGE BODY CHARGE TIME: 5 EFFECT: Immobilize someone within 10m: they cannot move voluntarily but they can still attempt Actions. The immobilized lasts for as long as the Flame is installed.

The Archeprimeval inspiration for the Sect was said to have traveled to Heaven and pissed everyone off. Worse, even the greatest philosopher of that era could not contain him in mystic Samadhi Fire. Only the highest intelligence—a human that attained Enlightenment—could contain the Mind Monkey.

License: Sage Body ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

Leap [10 x SAGE BODY] meters in any direction and then make a weapon attack. Suffer no falling damage if the fall is uninterrupted. Often used to interpose in between an attack and take the damage for someone else.

Wukonkg's tales became beacons of inspiration for the great revolutionaries of our time, especially Kafeng Masangwa, who sought to also attain Enlightenment Through Violence. "You're getting a bit too familiar with your grandfather, eh? Hahaha!" — Wukong Yug Ugung.

License: Sage Body ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂❂

While installed, all damage against the Cultivator is reduced by 1 and gives the cultivator a stack of TEMPER, to a limit of her [SAGE BODY]. When she uninstalls the Flame, she immediately deals [TEMPER] damage to a single hostile within weapon range and she loses all TEMPER.

“To be indestructible is not a matter of hardness, but of pliability. We Wukongs have leapt to the ends of the Trichiliocosm and learned from the Great Primeval Buddha the truth of defense and protection.” — SIX-ARMED THREE HEADED ASURA ARHAT

License: Sage Body ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂❂❂

The Cultivator plucks out one of her hairs and summons a clone of herself. The clone is physically real but only has a number of 2 Flame for use in Techniques. It has the same statistics as the cultivator. When a clone runs out of Flame or any part is Disabled, it dissipates and its memories and experiences return to the user. Unless someone have supernatural sense, they cannot know whether a Clone is a Clone or not. The Cultivator can only have up to 2 Clones active at a time.

At journey's end, the great Wukong, having attained Enlightenment, became the Victorious Fighting Buddha, escaping finally from the world as an Enlightened One.

License: Sage Body ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

MANTRA: QI TIAN DA SHENG MUDRA: HEAVEN -> EARTH -> MAN -> THUNDERBOLT -> LOTUS -> THUNDERBOLT -> WISDOM CHECK HRT + SAGE BODY CHARGE TIME 8 EFFECT: The Cultivator grows up to Size 2, and so does her Gear. While in this form, the Cultivator's weapon damage become innately [CRUSHING] and cannot be COUNTERED unless they're of the same Size or use esoteric means to do so.
system.mudra: HEAVEN -> EARTH -> MAN -> THUNDERBOLT -> LOTUS -> THUNDERBOLT -> WISDOM

system.description:
Exorcists are integral to the Revolutionary Army: the Forces of Reaction and Liberalism wield the Spirits the geists to strengthen their forces and fight back against revolutionary mysticks and wizards. A way to bind these entities is imperative. Thus why in the rebuilding of the Communist Party it became imperative to establish the Zhongkui Sect.

License: Spirit Binding ✦

Needs: ❂

MANTRA BAK YA MUDRA HEAVEN -> SWORD -> WISDOM CHECK HRT + SPIRIT BINDING CHARGE TIME 2 EFFECT Zhongkui creates an up to 10m long straight line anywhere on a solid surface. Spirits cannot cross these Partitions. For sentient beings these become low-hazy light walls that can be used as cover and is difficult to move through. If placed upon an object, the Zhongkui turns that object into an anathema to Spirits. Spirits fall away from the item, and using it as a weapon imbues that weapon with the [HOLY] property.

The oldest exorcist magick, taught by the spiritworkers and shamans of the old world. The world is the world of spirits, not of man. May we all attain concordance with Void.

License: Spirit Binding ✦

Needs: ✹✹

MANTRA ANG MANG SANG MUDRA WISDOM CHECK HRT + SPIRIT BINDING CHARGE TIME 6 EFFECT Target an entity within 20m.Make a FAC + SPIRIT BINDING vs HRT + SUSURRATION. If the caster wins, the target loses 1 Morale and is Stunned for 3s. If the target is an INTRA-INT, the caster can also install ❂ to Seal them into an object or another person. Sealing an INTRA-INT into another person risks Possession, so it is safer to put them into an object with a subtler Consciousness. The caster can Seal it to herself by losing 2 Morale. She can use 1 of the Spirit's Magicks or Abilities. While Sealed, the INTRA-INT knows it is the INTRA-INT that sealed them, and will act accordingly. The object that the Spirit inhabits will exhibit the Spirit’s features— a Fire Demon might set an object on fire, while a poltergeist might inflict KNOCKBACK equal to [1 + SIDHI STAGE].

"The vast majority of the Trichiliocosm now consists not of organic lifeforms like you and me. No, the Trichiliocosm is a Cosmos of Spirits. Billions, trillions years old. Living in Sidhi palaces enfolded into akashic dyad code." — Binder Ishaak of the Ghost Devouring Sword

License: Spirit Binding ✦✦

Needs: ❂

MANTRA HI WA MUDRA SWORD CHECK HRT + SPIRIT BINDING CHARGE TIME 2 EFFECT The caster summons a hair-thin line of Sword Sidhi to cut at any point within 20m. It cuts like a sword, and can be used to commit violence, dealing [SPIRIT BINDING] damage. If the target is an INTRA-INT, then this is true damage.

The ancient and primeval Seven-Star Constellation is inhabited by INTRA-INTs who are commonly known as the Seven Demon Kings—powerful Cultivators who established a long tradition of demon slaying and exorcism.

License: Spirit Binding ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

MANTRA BEI DOU MUDRA HEAVEN -> WISDOM -> NOOSE CHECK HRT + SPIRIT BINDING CHARGE TIME 6 EFFECT The caster summons a single point of light within 2m of her and then another point within 6m of that point. Stepping onto the point lets her next step be immediately into any other of the points summoned in the battlefield. Stepping into these points conserve momentum.A caster can only summon up to 7 points.

A technique created by the Devil Immortal Exorcist Yazatram of the Rutilant Coven, at first, to strengthen himself. Later, when he was transformed by a Cosmic Buddha, she chose to teach the Rite for good.

License: Spirit Binding ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

Upon dealing damage upon an INTRA-INT, activate this to devour their Sidhi. Deal +1 damage and then heal a chosen Part equal to the health the INTRA-INT lost. If the INTRA-INT's Part is Disabled or Cleaved because of this, the Cultivator enters Samadhi.

Numina are trickier. These are emergent informational patterns that arise from the dialectical movement of an ecosystem powered by Sidhi that sometimes inhabit an animal, or cobble together a coherent, mythic form. Appeasing these requires tapping into informational resonances, a form of mystic science that the ancestors had a sensitivity to through application of symbol. It's much less complicated to just eat them all.

License: Spirit Binding ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA NA LA PU RA MUDRA HEAVEN -> DRAGON CHECK HRT + SPIRIT BINDING CHARGE TIME 8 EFFECT The caster summons holy exorcist fire from any part of her. She can choose to lob this as a bomb up to 20m, reaching up to a 3m radius and dealing [SPIRIT BINDING] holy blast damage. She can choose to shoot this as a flame thrower, affecting a 10m long, 3m wide line from her. She can choose to install the Flame instead, allowing her to keep the Holy Fire as a floating orb near her that she can move to anywhere within 8m of her with just her will.

A magick perfectly formulated by the Angel Spirit King Tattanzon of Woe’s Fissure. She used it to find her wife in the Akasha, where ghosts dwell. She found nothing but truth.

License: Spirit Binding ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

MANTRA A SA KA MUDRA MAN -> NOOSE CHECK HRT + SPIRIT BINDING CHARGE TIME 8 EFFECT The caster drops some blood from the target or flowers from the target's grave. The blood or petals stay in the air and then snake towards the target being found. The trail lasts for as long as the Flame is Installed.

What the dead have sung they will sing again. In the Kingdom of Heaven they will remember my name. It is yet part of the training of Bidadari to memorize long concert pieces to be able to reproduce them with their own flourishes. Something soundstone recordings could never recreate.

License: Sound Law ✦

Needs: ❂

While installed, perfectly preserve the words, music, and visible movements of one performance that the Cultivator personally witnesses, up to 1 hour long. She can also use this to preserve her own performance. After an hour or until the Cultivator chooses, she must uninstall. Doing so banks it in her Music Bank, which can store up to [SOUND LAW] performances. Replace one when the limit is exceeded. When reproducing a preserved performance, the cultivator may manifest its original voices and instrumental sounds through her own voice. This reproduces what she heard, including errors and lies. It grants no understanding of unknown languages and carries no recorded supernatural effects.

Condense the Sidhic frequency of a sound into an echo, formed into a bubble. A favorite of some Sphere Aristocrats, when they wish to transfer the sound of their pet bidadari's performance across their 8 roofed pagodas.

License: Sound Law ✦✦

Needs: ❂

Perform a song up to 3 minutes long and then install the Flame: the last 3 minutes are immediately recorded into a floating sound bubble, 1m tall and 1m wide. It floats at a rate of 5m/s. By uninstalling or when it suffers damage, the bubble pops and it plays the entire recording. Should the Cultivator wish, she can intensify the echoing bubble pop by burning the Flame when it would be uninstalled to immediately deal 1 damage to all Parts and KNOCKBACK up to [FAC]m.

All Bidadari must learn how to wield their voice to speak the immortal language of the universe— tremendous, autophagous violence.

License: Sound Law ✦

Needs: ❂; an instrument in one hand or her voice

While installed, the Cultivator may use FAC + SOUND LAW for all KILL THE BUDDHA attacks. As she does, she performs throughout the KILL THE BUDDHA. She can also attack with her voice r the music of her instruments or claps or dance steps: 10m range, [FAC] true damage.She can turn this into a 3m radius fulmination, dealing [FAC-1] true damage to a random Part to all hostiles in radius.

system.description:
The Bidadari must make sure that her song is not a song of the self but the song of the people.

License: Sound Law ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂; an instrument in one hand or her voice

She can start dancing or playing music. While she does, she gains the following Actions: ✦ Sonic Flutter. Float [FAC] meters. ✦ Marching Beat. Up to [FAC] allies within 10m may move up to [FAC] meters for free. ✦ Hastening Song. Up to [FAC] allies within 10m gain +[SOUND LAW] Speed for 6 seconds.

system.description:
The Bidadari must then guide their allies to a victory they never thought they'd be able to attain.

License: Sound Law ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂; an instrument in one hand or her voice

While this is installed, she is thundering. Whenever she steps, she floats for 1m. She can perform the following songs: ✦ War Drum. Grant all allies within a [FAC] meter radius +2 to their next KILL THE BUDDHA. ✦ Rejuvenation Song: Burn the installed Flame to heal a random part by [FAC] HP all allies within a [FAC] meter radius.

system.description:
The teardrop known as the music note is known to be a potent way to stir conviction.

License: Sound Law ✦✦

Needs: ✹

When the Cultivator CHANGES GOD MIND through music or instrument, she can activate this to make the Check with [FAC + SOUND LAW]. She can also use this when attempting to apply Social Defense. If this is in an attempt to Inflame, the check gains +1.

It is the song that replenishes the mental integrity of all lifeforms, whether they be sapient or not. Perhaps the most popular of the bidadari's technicks, a Shennin capitalist was said to have been so addicted to the tune that he captured as many bidadari to keep it playing in a secret chasm behind his fifth mansion.

License: Sound Law ✦✦

Needs: ✹

Perform for up to 5 minutes, and then all within 30m that can hear and understand heal 1 Morale. If they have an Attachment to music, they heal 2 Morale.

Let the pale blue light be loss. Let the crimson moon be memory. What is holier than thee, o mighty stars? O, what if not mine own heart, keening thunderclap, listening o'er the dawn for a love unbidden, unbowed, and unreceived? A love lost exceedeth the sacredness of a love found.

License: Sound Law ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

The Cultivator immediately instills an emotion of painful loss and sorrow to all equal or lower Sidhi entities of the Cultivator's choice within 10m of her. The emotion is Firm and lasts for [SOUND LAW] days. This emotion affects their ability to commit violence, inflicting -1 to all their KILL THE BUDDHA Checks.

"The mob is no beast to be cowed, but a truth of ten thousand private souls, dreaming of a better life." — Apsaran Bidadari Verdigris Sun Xu Daqi, who led the local Risakans of the Charnel Isles to reject the settler colony of Ressen-Nalenji upon their island.

License: Sound Law ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

The Cultivator performs at least 3 minutes before a Mob and makes one Inflame against it, rolling FAC + SOUND LAW as the CHANGE GOD’S MIND Check. The Mob Size penalty is reduced by 2. On a success, the emotion evolves into a refrain: for an hour afterwards, it spreads without a new check to anyone who joins the Mob, up to one size larger than the Mob originally addressed. Each listener still decides how the emotion manifests.

A bidadari is often needed to pacify fears and hatreds. Some leathered aristocrats preferred to employ bidadari much like how one would employ opium.

License: Sound Law ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

The Cultivator unleashes a lilting, withering tune. All those that hear it within 10m must make a Demand [SOUND LAW] HRT + STILLNESS Check to stay awake. On a success, they instead feel off-balanced for the whole turn. On a failure, they fall asleep until they're awoken—every 3 ticks that pass, they have a [PHYS]-in-6 chance of waking up.

In the old Sphere-courts, a song is a message, a cry out against heaven. The INTRAJALA becomes an avenue for communication.

License: Sound Law ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

The Cultivator performs a single song into the INTRAJALA and uploads it to any INTRAJALA hosting site. She binds a CHANGE GOD'S MIND attempt to it like a WRITTEN SOCIAL ENGINEERING attempt, with +2 dice and without needing to specify a target. Those that attempt to defend against it may use CYBERNETIC HARUSPEX instead of just STILLNESS to resist. The broadcast is logged by DEVRENDRA, and the Intercessor may treat it as a trace to the origin Terminal. The singer may not know she is being traced.

Despite not being combatants, Bidadari have cultivated many technicks that allow them to crush their enemies and to strengthen themselves. Ever since the first Bidadari, Apsara Witraghni, was slain by a traveling death-monk, they have more and more oriented their technicks to a dual-effect philosophy.

License: Sound Law ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹; voice or instrument

The Cultivator unleashes an ultimate shockwave of sonic sidhi, washing across a 10m radius from her. All those she scorns are damaged equal to [FAC + 2] blast damage. All those she treasures are healed 3 HP to all Parts and 3 Morale. Those that hold a positive Firm Attachment to her also heal 1 burnt Flame. All those that can hear the sound made are immediately inflamed with a Held Emotion of her choice.

system.description:
Turns the Cultivator's voice into an exceedingly magnetic force. The Sapphire Star teaches that the ultimate violence is the violence that ends itself. And to do that is to focus on the social relations.

License: Dual ✦

Needs: ✹

When the Cultivator uses her voice and appeal to emotion to convince or strengthen an Attachment in someone, she may activate this to also implant an emotion of calm, peace, or trust (choose 1) toward her and immediately use it as leverage for the CHANGE GOD'S MIND attempt.

The Silkworm saith thus: "No soul is sundered from its fellow, distance is nothing but a promise of reconciliation. Read the seams between."

License: Dual ✦

Needs: ❂

While installed, the Cultivator sees sapphire soul threads joining every entity within sight: she knows a single Attachment one has to another. This just shows whether the Attachment exists, not its strength nor its context. Gleaning Attachments by using this grants +2d to the Check. Any entity with at least ✦✦✦ SUSURRATION can sense the gaze.

The Cultivator pours her Dual Sidhi into another and they strengthen each other. The Sapphire Star's signature technique, to support another is to support the world. The founder of the Sapphire Star cultivated this Technick out of regret for not saving his lovely paramour.

License: Dual ✦

Needs: ❂ + target's ❂

The Cultivator chooses one other person within 30m. As long as they're within 30m of each other and their Flames' are installed, they strengthen one another: they can use each other's Cores or Cultivation for Checks and weapon damage. This cannot be used to Dual Cultivate with more than one other person. At any point, the Cultivator and the target may, in tandem, burn the installed Flame to teleport next to each other (they choose which to teleport to) or to swap their places immediately.

A technick to pool together the fulminating charges of two sorcerers. Condensed from a long line of union ritual. As with any Dual technick, it often leads to either fire or fallout for either of the practitioners.

License: Dual ✦✦

Needs: ✹

When the cultivator performs a Magick, she may burn this to perform half the Mudras and have another person that she can hold hands with to perform the other half. Both perform the casting check (even if they do not have the Cultivation) and all Charges generated by both casters are pooled together toward the casting of the chosen Magick.

Allows the Cultivator to focus her mind and exude a presence of bladed emotion. Should violence be inevitable, even the diplomat must know how to wield her words like fanged razors.

License: Dual ✦

Needs: ❂

While installed, the Cultivator gains +1 to all attemptes to pacify violence. If she succeds in doing so, she implants an emotion of calm and forces the listeners to lower their weapons. While installed, she may use her presence to KILL THE BUDDHA: she may check FAC + DUAL. For every Strike she wins by, she can reduce the target's Morale.

Sapphire Star holds thusly that the first impression will last longer than an entity's actual memory of you. The Cultivator pulls on a thread that has not been made yet. Sapphire Stars love teaching this first— and often, most stop at this as well. A shame.

License: Dual ✦✦

Needs: ❂

When the Cultivator speaks with an entity that holds no Attachment toward her, she may activate this immediately. For 30 minutes, the target gains a faint, memoryless sense that he's known her all his life. Additionally, that person's starting Disposition cannot be lower than Neutral toward the cultivator. When the Cultivator takes an act of violence, theft, or deceit against him however, the Flame is burned and the target gains a Negative Held Attachment toward her.

Summons a blue star thread to bind around a word. Sapphire Stars have long needed to reckon with deception and its existence. To burrowed in obfusciation realm of words is to walk around with a noose around one's neck. The vaunted Sapphire Star Juxian wielded this to great degree: when the King of Unsanji, a hyperfeudal Sphere in the Outer Sectors found out about this, they created a miniature God Gate to separate her head from the rest of her corpus.

License: Dual ✦✦

Needs: ✹

After someone speaks, burn the Flame. A Sapphire Knot pulls out a particular word from that person's throat, as demanded by the Cultivator. After a moment, the Sapphire Knot binds around it: if it constricts the word, then that word has a deception. If it loosens, the word is sincere. This tests sincerity, not objective truth.

Sidhi extrudes from the cultivator, binding around those that can see or hear her, and makes her be understood. What is a diplomat that cannot connect? The purpose of thy power is to bind with a knot of camaraderie and rancor.

License: Dual ✦✦

Needs: ❂

While installed, anyone who sees the cultivator's deliberate gestures or hears her voice understands the meaning that she meant to communicate, and she can likewise understand statements deliberately addressed to her. Her CHANGE GOD'S MIND gains +1d. This removes the +3 dice Social Defense for gestural social engineering as well. This does not work for writing and it cannot compel attention supernaturally.

The fluctuating Sidhi becomes a point of deduction. The afeared technick of the silkmoths of Sapphire Star, for to know a single secret is to know every secret.

License: Dual ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

Strengthen a GLEAN attempt: activate this to immediately learn an Attachment that the target is actively attempting to hide, and then gain +1 dice to the Check. This cannot be used if the target is not actively hiding an Attachment.

A magick that burgeons from the cultivator's heart, creating a lattice of peace and neutrality. Used often for parleys, ancient armies made sure they had a Sapphire Star for parleying in the battlefield. Nowadays, corporations and Sects have them for ensuring no brawl breaks out amidst neutral grounds.

License: Dual ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

MANTRA: LU KA SHIN SU | MUDRA: Lotus → Stillness → Wisdom CHECK: FAC + DUAL CHARGE TIME: 8 | EFFECT: A 10m radius of sapphire lattice forms around the caster for as long as the Flame is installed. Before an entity of equal or lower Sidhi inside it may commit violence, it must pass HRT + STILLNESS vs Demand [DUAL CULTIVATION]. On a failure it cannot commit that violence and any more violence this Turn and loses 1 Morale. It can choose to lose 2 Morale to attack anyway. If the Cultivator harms anyone inside, or is Disabled, the lattice dissolves.

Among the Sapphire it is doctrine that: "a power kept by one hand is a power half used." More powerful Sapphire Stars are careful to use this technick—it has led to many instances of betrayal and broken hearts.

License: Dual ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂❂

Touch skin to skin with someone and install the Flame. The Cultivator can "lend" one of her Licenses with them to use. This cannot be as Gear License. The one using it must install ❂ to keep it as well. If either Cultivator uninstalls the Flame, they lose the License. Lending a License renders the Dual Cultivator unable to use that License, and she cannot have another Cultivator with this technick to "lend" it back to her.

The Silkworm teaches that for a diplomat to be true she must first learn to lie to herself.

License: Dual ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂/❂❂/❂❂❂

For every Installed Flame, the Cultivator may craft a fake Held/Firm/Heart Attachment. It can be read like a real Attachment but any attempts to CHANGE GOD'S MIND with it confers no advantage nor leverage.

The Silkworm saith thus: this rite is neither a shameful act nor a sacred one. It is a labor of labor all the same, as simple and as true as a human's ability to grasp, grasp, grasp...

License: Dual ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂❂

DEMAND 2 | DURATION 1 hour | GOAL 3 | LIMIT 3 CHECK: HRT + DUAL CULTIVATION. Partners are assistants and add their Strikes. Requires the free and willing consent of every participant. Up to [DUAL CULTIVATION] partners may join, as long as they have a positive attachment to the cultivator. The rite may be a union of bodies, or an hour of shared breath between those who love one another. The Sect teaches that the former is only the oldest method. Success: Each participant recovers 2 burnt Flame and Morale and each learns the other’s most defining Heart Attachment. Neither may conceal it, which has ended more than one seduction in the spy’s disfavor. Failure: The threads tangle, and each loses 1 Morale. A participant benefits from the ritual only once per week. Sex is a Content Warning of this game. Fade to black, or cross it out.

The Silkworm saith thus: "To be known is to be bruised, like fruit. To be understood is the same thing as being ruined. To say I love you is to say you love me. There is no such thing as loneliness: even time alone time spent with the world."

License: Dual ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

MANTRA A SAN KA NA SIN TA MUDRA Heaven → Noose → Wisdom → Stillness → Lotus CHECK FAC + DUAL CHARGE TIME 18 EFFECT Upon casting, for an hour, the Cultivator knows the full context of all Held and Firm Attachments and current Disposition from someone she's known for at least three days. If the caster is in Samadhi or enters Samadhi during the hour, she gleans all that person's Heart Attachments as well. Entities two higher Sidhi Stages cannot be read. Those of equal or one Stage higher may attempt to resist with an opposed HRT + STILLNESS vs the caster's FAC + DUAL CULTIVATION.
system.mantra: A SAN KA NA SIN TA

system.description:
Slide in, smooth. Not stylish, not suave, but friendly. They can trust you, right?

License: Consummate Lie ✦

Needs: ❂

While installed, the Cultivator's lies carry no physical tell: no flush, no tremor, no pause and she can speak a voice she's heard for a full minute perfectly: pitch, accent, breath. When she tells a lie while this is installed, she can burn ✹ to make the person believe in the lie temporarily for [CONSUMMATE LIE] minutes.

Trickster Devils, permeating across all cultures, have passed down their knowledge to create a Sect of Con Men, known as the Wicked Devil Grins. They cultivate confident and suave gentlemen that will exploit the social structures established by liberal society.

License: Consummate Lie ✦

Needs: ❂

While installed, the cultivator makes their attacks with wickedly misleading movements. She can user [FAC + CONSUMMATE LIE] when she KILLS THE BUDDHA with any melee weapon.

In an act of dialectical immanency, the Luciferians understood that the greatest liar would also be the greatest truth seeker.

License: Consummate Lie ✦

Needs: ✹

During an investigation in a particular scene, the cultivator may activate this to see through the eyes of someone that could've seen the scene of the crime for 3 seconds. This doesn't mean they see the scene of the crime during the crime but rather, they see the scene through the eyes of someone that could have feasibly seen the crime when it was taking place.

What is it with devils and gambling? Well, a real gambler only truly plays in one of two situations: when they know they'll win, or when they know the odds are stacked against them that they'll probably lose.

License: Consummate Lie ✦✦

Needs: ❂

Upon installing this, roll a single die and keep its result. When dice are rolled in the cultivator's vicinity, she may replace any of the rolled results with any of her kept dice. She can install multiple versions of this to keep multiple rolls.

The court gunwitch testified for a lie she believed in. It was true, at the time. But really now it just wasn't. You've heard of it before: the fact that the present can change the past.

License: Consummate Lie ✦✦

Needs: ✹

After the cultivator performs an action, she may activate this to immediately step 1m and leave behind an afterimage that carries out that Action. Then, she performs her real Action. When the afterimage is struck in any way, it vanishes into mist. Its original action is also only pantomimed—it can't actually hurt or cast magick or touch the world.

"He's not good. He's just lucky. He's attuned, you know. To that thing: synchronicity. Spooky stuff but old engineers used it to make Sidhi. You know, it's all wumbo mumbo quantum entanglement stuff. This technick just lets you follow the narrative." — Baron Ashio exlaining Synchronicty to young Eskatonian Hangsa Parami. Make all coincidences work for you.

License: Consummate Lie ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂❂

While installed, the cultivator is paracausally lucky. Fortune finds her. When making a non KILL THE BUDDHA Check, she can always reroll up to [CONSUMMATE LIE] dice.

The Hells aren't a dimension, no. They're a kind of Spherical Economy, according to the study of imperialism. The Heavens are the imperial core, the Earths are the beneficiaries, and the Hells are the ones exploited to keep the Heavens, well, Heavens. Hingsajagra is a Hell planet, by the way. So even if you die here, you're stuck here.

License: Consummate Lie ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂❂

Talk to the ghost of a corpse that has been dead for less than [its SIDHI] days. This is the akashic imprint of this entity. Check MND + CONSUMMATE LIE. For every Strike, the ghost answers. It can lie half the time.

Read the akashic imprint of a violent crime. Sometimes the easiest way to get evidence is to talk to it.

License: Consummate Lie ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

The cultivator presses her palm to the floor of a violent scene. She makes a MND + CONSUMMATE LIE Check. She sees a replay of the last [1 + STRIKES] seconds before the bloodstain, seen through the eyes of whoever was most afraid. This can be used to collect Facts, Established Premises, or other such evidences.

The thing about truth, the mind, and the unconscious is that the persona is sometimes truer than the shadow.

License: Consummate Lie ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

The Cultivator takes an hour after burning this to build a new Persona (name, history, Attachments [Held, Firm, Heart]). The Persona is real and has records in appropriate registries and bureau files. After making it, the cultivator may install ❂ to take on its face supernaturally. She looks perfectly like her persona, but anyone with a perfect Fact can break through the persona.

The other thing about the Truth is that an easy way to make someone believe you is to believe in what you think perfectly and impenetrably. That's the secret of truths.

License: Consummate Lie ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

The Cultivator states any lie, and then Checks FAC + CONSUMMATE LIE vs the one listerner's HEART + STILLNESS. On a failure, it's not believed in—it's hardly listened to. On a success, install the Flame to make the one listening believe in it as if it were a Fact, even though it isn't. He doesn't get any bonuses for the Fact, but the cultivator gets the Fact bonus when she exploits the Lie.

The thing about Truth is that there's only two ways to make something real: either you figure it out physically... or you make enough people believe the same thing. The first one is stronger, but the second one is easier to do.

License: Consummate Lie ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

Plant a lie in a Mob of Size 3 or more: a story about a person, monster, or place. If it spreads and holds, it condenses into a Tulpa: a kind of Goblin INTRA-INT that holds its own agenda. The cultivator may wear it as a Persona, point it a target, or leave it in the area. Of course, the Legend never forgets who started it. And it exists now: to get rid of it needs the appropriate means.

"Let's make this more interesting."

License: Consummate Lie ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

MANTRA: PAL DO MUDRA: HEAVEN -> SWORD -> THUNDERBOLT CHECK FAC + CONSUMMATE LIE CHARGE TIME 3 (RITUAL: 10 MINUTES) EFFECT: Mark an up to (10 x SIDHI) meter radius around a single point that the caster casted around. Anyone who knowingly enters or agrees plays by three Rules that the caster declares (e.g., "No lies." "No blades." "Bets in Flame only.") Violators lose Flame equal to the caster's Sidhi +1. If out of Flame, they start suffering the same amount as true damage to the head. The caster is the game master, so she can break one Rule per minute and it's legal. Nobody can leave while the game runs unless everyone (still alive) agrees to end it.

"Make them believe that they’ve got you." The Wicked Devil Grinner Ahm Sung knew that to be able to manipulate someone, you sometimes have to make them believe that they’ve successfully manipulated you. For this “never died” only if the corpse transgression, the revolutionary orchestrated the crumbling of a Capitalist Regime in the Far East. When the United Union of Peace found out about this, they immediately chased him down. He runs to this day.

License: Consummate Lie ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

As an Action, the Cultivator intramaterially rolls three dice. If it comes up as a triple (three of the same number), for 4 minutes and 11 seconds (the Sect's number, nobody knows why), the Cultivator goes into JACKPOT. Jackpot: This is considered as being in Samadhi. On top of Samadhi's benefits, the cultivator also has infinite Flame, every part heals half its max HP, and any Cleaved parts return to her. Bleeeding also stops and she becomes immune to Stun. When it ends Reality catches up with her: her Torso is Disabled, she gets -4 to all Checks.

items.name: Lie in the Face of God

system.description:
Deny something, even utter reality, and force your own for just a moment. What an interesting Enlightenment, this is. For a moment, as your whip cracks, you unleash the strength of another. A glimpse into a world where Cultivation is for All. Ahm Sung’s student, Tong Nam, staved off CYG paramilitary and adventurers to save Ahm Sung’s compromised position. It was a masterclass in talespinning. With a wink, he was completely gone. No one has ever seen him after that.

License: Consummate Lie ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂❂❂❂❂❂❂

The Sidhi Field answers to Mind and Will, so make it answer. The Cultivator states 1 false thing about the world to someone's face, and it becomes true. Whatever it is. However, there are Limits: ✦ Lies about what is persist until a Fact and an Experiment Unravel them. Lies about what physically exists persist until the Reckoning, then are Intercessor-adjudicated. ✦ You may rename, relocate, reorder and re-credit. You may not create matter from nothing, so a dead man becomes someone else. ✦ You may not change a Part’s HP, a Cultivation or a Sidhi rating directly. You may change who a person is on paper, where they are, and what they believe. ✦ You may not create Magicite, exceed the Realm caps, or bind an Immortal Demiurge or an Unsurpassable Universe Soul. ✦ You may not use it twice to the same Face in a day. The Face learns the shape of the lie. If the Cultivator is feeling lucky, she can burn the installed Flame to make a FAC + CONSUMMATE LIAR check vs an appropriate Demand (2 for small details, 4 for larger ones, 6 for grand changes, places, organizations). On a success, the Lie becomes truth and the cosmos rearranges to match. On a fail, the Heavenly Cosmic Ascendance Bureau flags the liar and she loses this License.

A strike filled with armor-destroying Sidhi. Kerissana is the vaunted daughter of Metom and is oft worshipped in Razru. Her lotus eyes and soft skin grant bliss to those that require succor. And yet she more often appears in her Fierce Deity Form, where with her six clawed hands she cracks and shatters the weapons of carnage and discord.

License: Black Mace ✦

Needs: ✹

Upon dealing damage to a Part with Armor, reduce the armor's DR by [DAMAGE DEALT x 2] and reduce the Armor's Soak by 1.

It is said that the Black Deity Metom formed the shapes of humanity today. To the extent that this is true is hotly debated. But the tribes of humanity have done stranger things to each other. And there are Gods beyond our ken…

License: Black Mace ✦

Needs: ❂

When the Cultivator KILLS THE BUDDHA, she may activate this to make her attack UNBLOCKABLE. When she deals damage, she uninstall this to release 2 blast damage to the target hit and then 2 blast damage to all objects and people within a 3m radius of the target.

Kerissana is often named as the more peaceful manifestation of Metom, who is a Wrathful Deity.

License: Black Mace ✦

Needs: ✹

The Cultivator as an Act may touch an item and restore its Durability by [3 x BLACK MACE]. If this is Armor, she can choose to restore 1 Soak to it instead.

The breastbone wheel is the heart of Metom: use it to defend yourself.

License: Black Mace ✦

Needs: ❂

Install when the cultivator would suffer Knockback: a black flywheel opens from you and takes the force, conserving the distance and direction. At any point, uninstall the Flame to travel that distance and direction, or use it upon damaging with a Bludgeon/ Whip to send the target that way. The Wheel can only hold 1 impact at a time.

In truth it is the workers that help build and assemble the vast and grand machines that help us take over the cosmos.

License: Black Mace ✦✦

Needs: ❂

Name one Project working on a physical thing, including a Crafting Project. Each willing worker who answers may work on the same project form their own station, no matter how far apart those stations are, allowing multiple people to feasibly work on a single project. When multiple people work on a project, the lead worker adds +1 per working person. Using this, the cultivator can only add up to [BLACK MACE x 2] extra workers to a project.

It is said that the Metomians' predecessor, the Secret Demiurgic Society, created and perfected the mechanism for morphing weapons. They sold it immediately to the Eternal Emperor.

License: Black Mace ✦✦

Needs: ❂

While installed, the Cultivator can freely morph any Morph weapons that they have without spending an Action. After morphing in such a way, they gain the FEROCIOUS +1 mod, though only once per tick.

Metom's Gunmetal Law says that to create something one must be willing to destroy something as well. This universe exists upon the debris of the previous one.

License: Black Mace ✦✦

Needs: ❂

Touch a manmade object and install the Flame. While installed, the cultivator remembers the exact dimensions of what she touched, and she can shape material in her hands to create an exact copy of it. It takes the same amount of time to make as the original. This cannot be larger than 3m by 3m.

Summon from within one’s self the perfect form: a pure black rod of bound Sidhi. Metom shaped us from the corpses of our older bodies, which evolved from primates. Which used to be bodies of light. Now no longer. We are material now.

License: Black Mace ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

A long cipher of mantra code erupts from the cultivator's chest, along with a pureblack rod that eats all ambient light, known as a Chakra Rod. 1 KG PRESTIGE BLUDGEON N/A METOMIAN CHAKRA ROD grip_ HAFT profile_ BLUDGEON material_ METOMIAN SIDHI mods_ FOCUS The Chakra Rod can be thrown up to 30m. It can be used to impale, even without a stabbing point. When thrown, it flies in a straight line, ignoring gravity and wind resistance, moving along Metom's Unseen Grid-Pattern. The Chakra Rod can transmit and transfer Sidhi. Upon dealing unsoaked damage, the wielder can drain 1 Flame from the target. The Chakra Rod can only drain up to 3 Flame in this way before exploding in a violent fulmination, 5m, dealing 10 blast damage to all caught in the fulmination.

Metom always carries around a Vajra Noose to tame demons and malevolent spirits.

License: Black Mace ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

A long cipher of mantra code erupts from the cultivator's chest, and that turns into an Adamantine Noose. 0.5 KG PRESTIGE BLUDGEON N/A METOMIAN CHAKRA ROD grip_ HANDLE profile_ WHIP material_ METOMIAN SIDHI mods_ REACH 4 +2 to all attempts to Control, bind, restrain with this. It can wrap around someone and keep them in place, as a Control. On a Controlled entity, can move them forcibly in any direction in 10m/s, but this ends the Control.

To forge upon the Black Crucible endorses eternity. Metom would call us blackened. Us humans. To keep us safe. To protect us from the fierce waves of suffering. From the Black Crucible arose Gnosis- Flame, of lucent color of oranges and blues, smelling of solder and sandalwood. It is said to be a holy fire, a Sidhi touched with Mad Enlightenment.

License: Black Mace ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂❂

Upon a manikin or puppet that the cultivator has made, they may billow out Gnosis-Flame from their mouth. These Battle-Puppets begin moving. They can only take orders and are not sentient, but can be outfitted. They must be commanded in a fight, and once commanded they continue that command until a new command is issued. They only follow the command of the one that has installed their Flame in them. Instead of Health, the Battle Puppets have 12 Durability per Part. They can hold a single License that the cultivator knows.

Metom is the God of Machinery, said to have been the arch-enemy of Ziben.

License: Black Mace ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

Upon installing, the Cultivator's forearm explodes into a porcelain flower, revealing black sinew wirings underneath. It is a living length of black cable up to [BLACK MACE X 3]m long. It can be pulled out and have either end attached to any end, or even the herself. Upon uninstalling at any point, the wire reels in, drawing the freeer end toward the better anchor. This can be used to pull one person into another, unless there is a mass imbalance.

Meditate and visualize yourself as the Heaven-Hell Architect Metom.

License: Black Mace ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

Burn when embarking on a Weapon or Armor Crafting Project to reduce the Duration to 1 minute and it can be done without tools or workshops, just the appropriate materials and the cultivator's hands.
